title: Academic Legal Research and Writing Training Program  (Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative and Academic Support)
job_title: Academic Legal Research and Writing Training Program  (Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative and Academic Support)
description: Academic Support and Learning Program Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative Our church nonprofit is building a long term academic learning and program testing initiative for individuals who may later support nonprofit education, tutoring, guidance, and community based programs. This is a paid remote learning program for applicants who enjoy studying, learning, writing, research, academic support work, and structured online learning. This opportunity is for paid learning participants who want to grow in a school like learning environment while helping us test and develop academic programs for future nonprofit use. Please Read Before Applying Please read this full post carefully before applying. We are busy church and nonprofit workers, so we are looking for applicants who can follow written instructions without asking many questions that are already answered in this post. Please read the post more than once before applying. Do not apply if you are going to ask questions that are already answered here. This is not a high paying opportunity. This is a paid learning and program testing initiative for people who genuinely enjoy studying, writing, research, and learning new things. Please do not apply if: • You do not read instructions carefully • You cannot follow directions • You are not qualified • You are not familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms • You are not familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems • You are not comfortable with the honorarium budget • You are not interested in learning or studying • You are not willing to work in a structured academic environment • You cannot communicate clearly and respectfully • You cannot provide daily progress updates • You cannot submit quality academic work • You do not have reliable access to a computer and internet This opportunity is best for someone who loves to study, enjoys learning new things, communicates well, writes clearly, and may later become a strong academic support person for nonprofit related programs. Purpose of the Program This nonprofit initiative helps us test, evaluate, and improve academic learning programs before they are used more broadly. Participants will: • Study assigned learning materials • Complete structured academic modules • Produce original written work and presentations • Help evaluate program quality, clarity, difficulty, and structure • Provide consistent progress updates • Demonstrate reliability, discipline, and quality academic effort • Work independently in a self paced online learning environment This is a program testing and learning participant role. Minimum Requirements Applicants must meet the following requirements: • Must be a college graduate • Must have a good GPA or strong academic record • Must provide proof of graduation • Must provide diploma, certificate of graduation, or equivalent proof • Must provide Transcript of Records or official school transcript • Must have strong reading, writing, research, and study skills • Must be very studious and able to learn independently • Must be comfortable with self paced online learning • Must be familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms • Must be familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems • Must be familiar with discussion boards and online course style learning • Must know or be willing to follow APA academic writing format • Must have regular access to a reliable PC or laptop • Must have stable internet access • Must be able to submit clean, organized, and quality academic work • Must communicate consistently and provide progress updates Who Should Apply This opportunity is best for: • College graduates with strong academic habits • College degree holders with good academic records • Straight A students or applicants with strong study discipline • People who love to learn and study • People who enjoy academic writing and research • People who are organized and detail oriented • People interested in tutoring, academic support, nonprofit work, or program testing • People who can work independently without constant supervision • People who are reliable, respectful, and serious about finishing what they start • People who are available, responsive, and comfortable working online Character and Reliability Required Before anything else, character and reliability come first. We carefully evaluate character during the first sessions. Many people may be intelligent or academically capable, but if we do not see reliability, respect, honesty, quality work, and strong work ethic early on, we will not be able to continue with that applicant. We are looking for people who: • Follow through on commitments • Communicate respectfully • Provide consistent progress updates • Complete assignments they start • Take responsibility seriously • Stay responsive and professional • Show honesty, discipline, and good character • Take pride in producing clean and quality work • Have strong study habits and academic discipline • Learn well independently • Care about details and accuracy If an applicant stops responding, disappears, abandons work midway, submits careless work, or fails to communicate, the program will end for that applicant. Our nonprofit depends on people who finish the work they start and care about the quality of what they submit. About the Training Program Participants will complete structured study modules and produce academic work. The program includes: • Research based paper • PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes • Organized written work based on assigned topics • Proper citations and references • Discussion board style learning activities when assigned • Final capstone project The program evaluates: • Writing ability • Research and analysis • Communication • Discipline and consistency • Professionalism • Integrity • Ability to learn and follow instructions • Quality of submitted work • Attention to detail This program is designed for applicants who enjoy studying and learning and want to strengthen their academic and professional skills. Pay and Program Structure • Honorarium ranges from PHP 4,500 for beginners to PHP 7,000 after passing the first stage per completed program • Final honorarium may depend on the agreement, applicant qualifications, program track, work quality, and completion requirements • Program includes 15 structured modules • Program length is approximately 8 weeks • Program is self paced and competency based • Strong applicants often finish in about 7 weeks • Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work • Applicants must complete the full program requirements • Poor quality, incomplete, careless, copied, or non original work will not be accepted Each module requires: • APA style essay • PowerPoint presentation with speaker notes • Proper citations and references • Organized academic writing • Original work • Quality writing and clear presentation Module 15 is the final capstone project. Available Program Tracks Applicants must choose one program track. • Program A: Criminal Justice and Community Safety. Topics include justice systems, criminology, crime prevention, and community safety. • Program B: Healthcare Administration and Community Health. Topics include healthcare systems, health policy, healthcare management, and community health programs. • Program C: Nursing, Health Promotion, and Community Care. Topics include community health nursing, prevention strategies, patient education, and health promotion. • Program D: United States Studies. Topics include United States history, society, culture, and civic institutions. • Program E: Business and Administration. Topics include business writing, management, leadership, organizational behavior, marketing, business ethics, operations, and administration. • Program F: Recreation, Tourism, and Hospitality. Topics include recreation management, tourism studies, hospitality service, event planning, customer experience, community recreation, and travel development. • Program G: Law and Legal Studies. Topics include legal research, legal writing, case analysis, legal ethics, public policy, legal systems, and access to justice. Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement Academic writing in APA style is mandatory. Applicants are expected to already be strong in: • Writing • Research • Organization • Citations • Academic formatting • Quality academic work All work must be original and written by the applicant. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as: • Brainstorming • Outlining • Grammar review • Study support However: • Copying is not allowed • Plagiarism is not allowed • AI generated submissions are not allowed • Careless rewriting or copied content is not allowed • Sources must be cited properly in APA style • Originality checks may be used through Turnitin or similar review systems • Work must be suitable for originality review because it is genuinely original, properly cited, and written honestly • Applicants must submit only their own original work We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at academic work and can write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them. What This Can Lead To Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistent performance, and quality work may be invited into ongoing paid work supporting our nonprofit programs. We continue working only with people who show: • Reliability • Consistent communication • Dependable work quality • Professionalism • Trustworthiness • Respectful attitude • Strong academic effort • Careful and quality submissions How to Apply Email : ---------- Message also through WhatsApp if you receive no response: ---------- Please include: • Updated resume • Full name and timezone • Daily availability in hours per day • Program choice A, B, C, D, E, F, or G • Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style • PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes • Confirmation statement below Confirmation Statement “I understand this is a nonprofit academic learning and program testing initiative. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.” Required documents: • Resume or portfolio • Proof of graduation • School diploma, front and back • Transcript of Records, front and back • Proof of GPA or academic standing, if available For nursing graduates, please also include if available: • BSN diploma • CHED verification of degree equivalency • RN license copy Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview. description: I am looking for a skilled Graphic Designer / Virtual Assistant to help with artwork preparation for a custom printing and apparel business. We work with DTF transfers, t-shirts, apparel graphics, logos, client artwork, mockups, and print-ready files. Many clients send low-quality images, screenshots, blurry logos, or raster files, so I need someone who can clean up artwork, redraw designs, and prepare professional files that are actually ready for printing. This role is ideal for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, and understands how to prepare artwork for apparel printing. Main Responsibilities You will help with tasks such as: Redrawing low-quality logos into clean vector files Manually tracing artwork in Adobe Illustrator Converting raster images into vector files when possible Cleaning up blurry, pixelated, or low-resolution artwork Removing backgrounds and preparing transparent PNG files Preparing print-ready files for DTF transfers and apparel printing Creating t-shirt designs from ideas, references, or client concepts Creating simple logo concepts and brand graphics Sizing artwork correctly for shirts, hoodies, bags, and other products Creating mockups to show clients how designs may look on apparel Organizing design files clearly in Google Drive or another file system Making revisions based on feedback Required Skills Please apply only if you are comfortable with: Adobe Illustrator Adobe Photoshop Manual vector tracing Logo redraws Raster image cleanup Transparent PNG files Print-ready file setup Typography and layout design Apparel/t-shirt design Following instructions carefully Communicating clearly and asking questions when needed Important Please put the word DTF as the very first word at the top of your application so I know you read this section carefully. Bonus Skills These are not required, but they are a big plus: DTF printing experience Screen printing file preparation Color separations Spot colors Halftones Pantone color matching Gang sheet layout Canva Figma Procreate CorelDRAW Experience working with print shops, apparel brands, or promotional products The Type of Designer I’m Looking For I am not only looking for someone who can make things look nice. I need someone who understands clean artwork and print production. For example, if a client sends a small blurry logo, I need you to know whether it can be cleaned up, needs to be manually redrawn, or needs to be recreated from scratch. I am looking for someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into something professional, clean, and usable for printing. You should be able to understand things like: “This image is too low-quality, but I can redraw it.” “This file is okay for a mockup, but not good enough for printing.” “This design needs cleaner edges before we print it.” “I can make this into a transparent PNG and vector file.” “This logo has too many colors for screen print unless we simplify it.” “This design may need halftones, spot colors, or separations depending on the print method.” Examples of Work You May Be Given A client sends a screenshot of a logo and wants it on a shirt A business has a rough logo idea and needs a clean version A customer sends a photo and wants text added around it A design needs to be cleaned up for DTF printing A t-shirt idea needs to be created from a description A low-resolution PNG needs to be rebuilt as a vector file A design needs to be mocked up on a shirt A file needs to be prepared at the correct size with a transparent background A design may need simplified colors for screen printing Application Requirements When applying, please include: Your experience with Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop Examples of logo redraws or vector tracing work Examples of t-shirt or apparel designs you have made Before-and-after examples if you have them Any experience you have with DTF, screen printing, or print shops Any experience with halftones, spot colors, or color separations What file formats you can provide, such as AI, SVG, EPS, PDF, PNG, PSD, etc. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate Your availability and preferred work schedule A short explanation of how you would handle a blurry low-resolution logo that a client wants printed on a shirt Please do not only send Canva designs. Canva is okay as an extra tool, but this position requires Illustrator and Photoshop skills. At the very bottom of your application, please write SCREEN PRINT as the last line.

description: Google Flow AI Generation VA — Long-Term, Recurring Weekly Pay Apex Initiative · TikTok Shop Affiliate Coaching PAY: $5 USD per hour, paid every Sunday via Wise or PayPal. Work week is Monday–Saturday. Typical hours: 30–45 per week depending on volume (each project ~30 minutes). SCHEDULE: 6 days per week, flexible within your timezone TYPE: Long-term, recurring hourly work — NOT a one-off gig START: Immediate ——————————————————— WHAT WE DO Apex Initiative is a coaching company helping students build TikTok Shop affiliate businesses in the UK and US. We produce all our content using Google Flow (Google's AI video tool), and we're building a small, stable team of long-term VAs to handle daily generation work for our coaching clients. ——————————————————— WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY You'll work directly inside the student's Google Flow account (they share the login with you) using Nano Banana Pro for image generation and Flow's animation for video. The student (or our team lead) sends you a set of "projects" daily. One project = approximately 25–30 base product images pulled from KaloData (the TikTok Shop product research tool). Most students send 2–4 projects per day, depending on how many TikTok accounts they're running. For each project, you will: 1. Log into the student's Google Flow account 2. For each base image in the project: use Nano Banana Pro to generate an AI creative image following our standard image prompt 3. Animate that creative image into a short video using our standard video prompt 4. Save the finished video to a Google Drive folder named "Project 1," "Project 2," etc. (numbering resets every day) 5. Repeat for all 25–30 base images in the project A skilled VA completes one project in about 30 minutes. At end of day, you hand off the day's Drive folders to the assigned Posting VA, who pulls from your folders and handles the actual TikTok posting. You'll coordinate directly with the Posting VA via ---------- or Line so the handoff is clean. The student tells the Posting VA which project goes to which account — you just need to make sure the project folders are labeled correctly and uploaded on time. ——————————————————— WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - Excellent written English - Reliable high-speed internet (Google Flow is browser-based, bandwidth matters) - Modern computer or laptop with Chrome browser (smartphone is NOT enough for this role) - 6 days/week availability - Strong attention to detail — you'll need to judge whether each AI output is usable - Comfortable following SOPs precisely (no improvising) - Comfortable coordinating daily with another VA (the Posting VA who pulls from your Drive folders) Bonus: prior experience with AI generation tools (Midjourney, ChatGPT, Runway, Google Flow, Sora, Nano Banana, etc.) ——————————————————— HOW TO APPLY Send the following: 1. A 2–3 minute Loom video — introduce yourself, your VA experience, and mention any experience with AI tools 2. Your resume or CV 3. Your timezone + weekly availability (hours/day, days/week) 4. Confirmation you have a computer with Chrome, reliable internet, and can commit 6 days/week 5. Type the phrase "APEX-READY-GENERATION" at the top of your application so we know you read this in full Applications missing item #5 will not be reviewed. We get a lot of applications and use this to filter for people who actually read the listing. ——————————————————— 3-DAY PAID TRIAL If we like your application, you move into a 3-day paid trial period: - We walk you through our full Google Flow Generation SOP via Loom + a short 1:1 call so you know exactly what to do - You're assigned to one of our students (you use their Google Flow account login) - You generate the daily target of AI images + videos for 3 days, following the prompts exactly - We monitor your output daily and give feedback in real time - Pay during the trial: regular $5/hour rate for all hours worked — no unpaid testing - Pass the trial = you continue with that student permanently - If it's not the right fit, we release you with full pay for hours worked ——————————————————— WHY WORK WITH APEX - Stable weekly income paid every Sunday — predictable, never late - Long-term role (we want VAs for 6+ months minimum) - Work directly with cutting-edge AI tools — Google Flow and Nano Banana Pro are some of the newest in the space - Clear written SOPs — you never have to guess what to do - Friendly, organized team - Performance-based raises after 90 days - Path to a VA Manager role for top performers If you're looking for a real long-term job and want to grow with a stable team, we'd love to hear from you. — Apex Initiative Team

description: Hi! I run a YouTube channel focused on glow-up, skincare, and beauty content for a young female demographic. You will copy the script into a Google Doc. You will hunt down the perfect TikTok videos that visually represent what is being said in the script. You will paste the TikTok link directly next to or underneath the corresponding line in the script, ensuring the video changes roughly every 4 words. STRICT Clip Requirements (Please read carefully): The Vibe: Must fit the US "Clean Girl/That Girl" / Aesthetic vibe. Target Demographic: Videos must feature everyday relatable girls (White, Black, Latina, etc.) that match a US audience. Zero Text: All clips MUST be high-quality/HD and have NO words or text overlays on the screen. No Talking Heads: Avoid clips of people talking directly to the camera or lip-syncing. No Celebrities/Mega-Influencers: Use everyday creators. Do not use highly recognizable celebrities. Emotions & Expressions: Sometimes add clips showing facial expressions and emotions (e.g., looking frustrated about bad skin, looking happy about a product) rather than just blank stares. Repetition Limits: You may repeat a creator's TikTok one extra time per video, but the two clips must look completely different. The Ideal Candidate: Has a strong understanding of TikTok and current beauty/skincare aesthetics. Has incredible attention to detail (can follow the strict rules above without being micromanaged). Is highly organized and communicative. How to Apply: Because attention to detail is so important for this role, please follow these exact steps when applying: Start your proposal with the word "GLOWUP" so I know you read this entire post. Please provide 3 links to TikTok videos that you think perfectly fit the aesthetic, following ALL the rules above (No text on screen, high quality, no talking to the camera, no celebs). Briefly tell me about your experience and why you’d be a great fit for the team! I look forward to working with you!

title: Social Media Designer & Content Strategist
description: # Job Title: Social Media Designer & Content Strategist ## Company: Atmospheric Thinking ## Position Type: Social Media / Content Design / Digital Marketing ## Department: Social Media & Brand Marketing ## Reports To: Project Manager / Marketing Manager / Operations Lead ## Role Type: Internal Team Role ## Client-Facing: No phone or video calls required ## About the Role Atmospheric Thinking is looking for a **Social Media Designer & Content Strategist** to support internal and external social media projects across multiple brands, clients, platforms, and campaigns. This role is ideal for someone who is creative, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing a large volume of social media design and strategy work. The ideal candidate should be able to create unique, brand-aligned social media graphics in Canva, write captions and post descriptions, conduct hashtag research, schedule content consistently, review analytics, and stay up to date on platform trends and algorithm changes. This position will support social media work for both **client accounts and internal Atmospheric Thinking projects**. The person in this role should be comfortable creating content for platforms such as **LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , Reddit, TikTok, and other major social media platforms**. This is not a client-facing role involving phone calls or video meetings. However, this role will still support client and internal deliverables, including social media calendars, post designs, captions, hashtag research, analytics dashboards, posting reports, draft email s, revision notes, and project updates. The team will also have **daily start-of-day calls** to review current tasks, priorities, blockers, deadlines, and expectations. ## Key Responsibilities ### Social Media Design * Design unique, professional, and brand-aligned social media posts using Canva. * Create social media graphics for multiple clients, internal brands, campaigns, and content calendars. * Design content for platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , Reddit, TikTok, and other relevant social channels. * Create different types of social media assets, including static posts, carousels, story graphics, reels covers, short-form video graphics, quote posts, announcement graphics, educational posts, promotional posts, and brand awareness content. * Follow client and internal brand guidelines, including colors, fonts, logos, tone, visual direction, and content preferences. * Adapt designs for different social media platforms, dimensions, audiences, and content goals. * Create fresh designs that avoid looking repetitive across clients or campaigns. * Revise designs based on internal feedback, client notes, performance data, and project manager instructions. * Maintain organized Canva files, templates, folders, and design assets. ### Content Strategy & Caption Writing * Write clear, engaging, and brand-aligned social media captions and post descriptions. * Create content ideas that support brand awareness, engagement, education, lead generation, and community growth. * Adjust messaging based on platform, audience, brand voice, and campaign goals. * Support social media content calendars by developing post topics, caption drafts, design ideas, and posting schedules. * Research relevant hashtags for each client, brand, platform, and campaign. * Select hashtags based on brand alignment, audience targeting, reach potential, awareness goals, and platform best practices. * Help identify content themes, recurring series, campaign ideas, and seasonal opportunities. * Ensure social media content feels thoughtful, polished, and aligned with each brand’s goals. ### Platform Knowledge The ideal candidate should understand how to design and plan content for platforms such as: * LinkedIn * Instagram * Facebook * Reddit * TikTok * YouTube Shorts * Pinterest * Threads * X / Twitter * Other emerging or relevant platforms The candidate should understand that each platform has different expectations for content style, formatting, audience behavior, caption structure, hashtag usage, and posting cadence. ### Social Media Scheduling & Consistency * Schedule social media posts regularly across approved platforms and tools. * Help maintain a consistent posting cadence for each client and internal brand. * Organize content calendars so posts are planned, reviewed, approved, and scheduled on time. * Track what has been posted, what is scheduled, what is pending review, and what still needs to be created. * Coordinate with internal tea ---------- mbers to ensure design, captions, hashtags, and scheduling are completed correctly. * Flag missing assets, unclear instructions, approval delays, or scheduling conflicts early. * Help improve content consistency across multiple accounts and campaigns. ### Social Media Analytics & Reporting * Review post performance, engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, clicks, shares, comments, saves, and other relevant metrics. * Help prepare social media analytics dashboards and reporting summaries. * Identify which types of content are performing well and which may need improvement. * Use analytics to recommend adjustments to content style, posting cadence, hashtags, captions, and platform strategy. * Prepare internal and client-facing notes summarizing social media performance, completed work, upcoming posts, and recommended next steps. * Support draft email s, report notes, dashboard updates, revision summaries, and other deliverables related to social media performance. ### Trend & Algorithm Awareness * Stay up to date on social media platform updates, algorithm changes, design trends, content trends, and best practices. * Monitor changes across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , Reddit, TikTok, and other major platforms. * Research new content formats, engagement tactics, posting strategies, and platform-specific opportunities. * Recommend ways clients and internal brands can adjust their social media content to stay relevant. * Bring new ideas to the team based on emerging trends, platform updates, and audience behavior. * Understand how platform changes may impact reach, engagement, posting cadence, hashtags, and content format. ### Project Management & Organization * Use ClickUp or similar project management systems to manage tasks, deadlines, content calendars, updates, revisions, and deliverables. * Handle a large caseload of social media projects across multiple clients and internal brands. * Keep tasks updated consistently with progress notes, blockers, completed work, pending items, and next steps. * Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities, active work, deadlines, and current tasks. * Communicate clearly when work is completed, delayed, blocked, or ready for review. * Manage multiple social media calendars and deliverables at once without losing track of details. * Follow internal processes, naming conventions, documentation standards, and project workflows. * Stay organized across Canva, ClickUp, Google Drive, social media scheduling tools, and reporting documents. ## Client & Internal Deliverable Support Although this role is not client-facing through phone or video calls, it will involve preparing and supporting client and internal deliverables such as: * Social media graphics. * Social media captions. * Hashtag research. * Content calendars. * Posting schedules. * Social media analytics dashboards. * Monthly or weekly posting reports. * Draft email s. * Revision notes. * Post performance summaries. * Campaign ideas. * Social media strategy notes. * Internal project updates. * Screenshots, examples, and documentation when needed. ## Required Skills & Experience * Experience creating social media graphics using Canva. * Strong understanding of social media content strategy. * Experience designing content for multiple platforms such as LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , Reddit, TikTok, and other major platforms. * Ability to write clear, engaging captions and post descriptions. * Experience conducting hashtag research. * Understanding of brand alignment, audience targeting, and content consistency. * Ability to schedule posts and maintain a consistent posting cadence. * Familiarity with social media analytics and performance reporting. * Ability to review performance data and identify content improvement opportunities. * Comfortable using ClickUp or another project management system. * Ability to manage multiple clients, brands, calendars, and deadlines at once. * Strong written communication skills. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to provide consistent project updates without needing constant reminders. * Ability to follow instructions, revise work based on feedback, and meet deadlines. ## Preferred Skills * Experience working for a marketing agency, social media agency, digital agency, or multi-client environment. * Experience managing social media calendars for multiple brands at once. * Experience with social media scheduling tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Metricool, or similar platforms. * Experience creating short-form video concepts, reels covers, TikTok graphics, and carousel posts. * Experience with basic video editing in Canva, CapCut, or similar tools. * Experience with Google Sheets and Google Docs. * Experience creating analytics dashboards or social media performance reports. * Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools for caption drafting, content ideas, hashtag research, and workflow support. * Basic understanding of SEO, brand positioning, and content marketing. * Strong visual taste and ability to create designs that feel fresh, modern, and platform-appropriate. ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys both the creative and strategic sides of social media. They should be able to design strong visuals, write captions, research hashtags, organize content calendars, review analytics, and keep multiple projects moving at once. This person should understand that social media is not just about posting frequently. It is about creating content that fits the brand, speaks to the right audience, supports business goals, and adapts to each platform. They do not need to speak with clients on calls, but they should understand that their work directly supports client and internal deliverables. Their designs, captions, calendars, analytics notes, and reports should be clean, organized, and ready for internal review. ## Daily Expectations * Attend daily start-of-day calls to review priorities and current tasks. * Check ClickUp or the assigned project management system regularly. * Update tasks with progress, blockers, completed work, and next steps. * Create social media graphics in Canva. * Write captions, descriptions, and hashtag sets. * Schedule approved posts. * Review social media analytics and prepare reporting notes. * Maintain content calendars for multiple clients and internal projects. * Communicate clearly when something is completed, delayed, blocked, or needs review. ## Success in This Role Looks Like * Social media designs are creative, polished, and brand-aligned. * Captions and hashtags support each brand’s voice, audience, and goals. * Posts are scheduled consistently and on time. * Content calendars are organized and easy for the team to review. * ClickUp tasks are consistently updated. * Internal tea ---------- mbers always know the status of assigned social media projects. * Analytics are reviewed and turned into useful recommendations. * The person can manage a large caseload without losing track of details. * Client and internal deliverables are professional and ready for review. * The candidate stays aware of platform trends, algorithm changes, and social media best practices. * Daily communication is clear, reliable, and helpful. ## Work Style This role is best for someone who is: * Creative. * Organized. * Detail-oriented. * Strong at written communication. * Comfortable with fast-moving projects. * Reliable with deadlines. * Good at juggling multiple brands and content calendars. * Comfortable using Canva daily. * Interested in social media trends and platform changes. * Open to feedback. * Able to work independently after receiving direction. * Comfortable using project management tools. * Able to turn ideas into polished social media content. ## Summary The **Social Media Designer & Content Strategist** at Atmospheric Thinking will create social media designs, captions, hashtag research, content calendars, scheduled posts, analytics summaries, and internal/client deliverables for multiple brands and projects. This role requires strong Canva skills, platform knowledge, social media strategy, organization, and the ability to manage a high-volume workload with clear and consistent communication.

description: We are an American technology company building a line of IoT hardware products for the professional B2B market. This is not a one-off freelance project. This is an ongoing role on a small, focused team. You will be our hardware person. We have multiple products planned over the next 1–2 years, starting with a battery-powered e-paper display system. Our software and firmware are handled by a separate team. Your focus is the physical electronics: circuit board design, component selection, PCB ordering, and coordination with mechanical/enclosure designers. What You Will Do • Design schematics and PCB layouts in KiCad based on specifications we provide • Select components and source parts from LCSC, Mouser, DigiKey, and AliExpress • Generate manufacturing files and order assembled PCBs from JLCPCB • Read datasheets, verify pin assignments, check footprints, and confirm compatibility before ordering • Troubleshoot assembled boards (we will provide test equipment as needed) • Coordinate with enclosure designers on board dimensions, mounting holes, and connector placement • Maintain organized project files in Git (we will set up repositories for you) • Communicate daily via chat/messaging and weekly via video call Current Project Your first project is two small I2C expansion boards for an ESP32-S3-based e-paper display product: Board A - Button Strip: A long narrow PCB (~260mm × 15mm) carrying an MCP23017 GPIO expander, 7 IP67 sealed tactile switches, a WS2812B addressable RGB LED, an LIS3DH accelerometer, a DRV5032 hall effect sensor, a piezo buzzer with MOSFET driver, ESD protection, and Qwiic/STEMMA QT connectors. Standard I2C bus, 3.3V logic, straightforward 2-layer board. Board B - NFC Reader: A small PCB carrying a PN532 NFC module and a Qwiic connector. Very simple board. Additionally: specify battery contacts and wiring harness for a 21700 lithium cell, and create a connection guide documenting how the expansion boards wire to the main driver board. The full technical specification for these boards is already written and will be provided to the person we hire. All design decisions have been made: component choices, I2C addresses, pin allocations, connector types. Your job is to translate the specification into working KiCad files, order boards from JLCPCB, and verify they work. Future Projects After the expansion boards, upcoming hardware work includes: • Enclosure design coordination (working with a mechanical designer) • A barcode/document scanner accessory • RFID scanners • Possible custom main board (consolidating the current off-the-shelf driver board into a single integrated PCB) • Other IoT accessories for our product platform This role grows as the product line grows. ________________________________________ Requirements Must Have • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or closely related field • Ability to read and understand component datasheets, application notes, and reference designs • Working knowledge of basic electronics: I2C, SPI, GPIO, pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, voltage regulators, MOSFETs • Experience with KiCad (Or strong willingness to learn. If you know Altium, Eagle, or EasyEDA, KiCad will come quickly.) • Experience ordering PCBs from JLCPCB, PCBWay, or similar fab houses • Careful and detail-oriented - you double-check footprints before ordering, you verify pin assignments against the datasheet, you ask questions when something is unclear • Strong written English communication • Reliable internet connection and availability during overlapping work hours (we are in US Pacific time, UTC-8) Nice to Have • Experience with ESP32 or other microcontroller platforms • Experience with I2C sensor boards, GPIO expanders, or NFC modules • Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control • Experience with JLCPCB's SMT assembly service specifically (BOM formatting, CPL files) • Any experience with e-paper/e-ink displays • Experience with consumer or IoT product development (not just academic projects) • RF or antenna design Not Required • Firmware or software development (we handle this) • Mechanical / enclosure design (potentially separate role, but you will coordinate with that person) • High-speed digital or power electronics Strong Bonus Experience with 3D CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks) for enclosure design. Our products require custom 3D-printed enclosures, and a candidate who can own both the electronics and the enclosure design will be prioritized and compensated at the higher end of the range. If you have designed and 3D-printed enclosures for electronics projects - even personal or academic projects - please include photos, CPL files) ________________________________________ Work Arrangement • Hours: 20 hours per week to start, with potential to increase as projects grow • Schedule: Flexible, but we need at least 2–3 hours of overlap with US Pacific time (evenings in the Philippines typically work well) for real-time communication • Communication: Daily async updates via chat (Slack or similar), weekly 30-minute video call for project sync • Tools we provide: GitHub repository access, KiCad project templates, all component datasheets and specifications, JLCPCB account or reimbursement for fabrication orders • Duration: Ongoing, long-term. This is not a 1-month contract. We are building a multi-year product line and want someone who grows with us. ________________________________________ Compensation ?45,000–65,000/month (~$800–1,200 USD) Payment monthly via bank transfer, PayPal, or Wise. ________________________________________ How to Apply Please provide: 1. Your resume or CV with education, work experience, and any relevant projects 2. 2 or more examples of PCBs you have designed - KiCad screenshots, Gerber renders, or photos of assembled boards. Academic projects are fine if you have no professional examples. If you have not designed a PCB before, please be honest about that. 3. A brief message (3-5 sentences) explaining why this role interests you and what relevant experience you have 4.     A short video introduction (1–2 minutes, phone camera is fine). Please tell us your name, your educational background, one electronics project you've worked on that you're proud of, and why this role interests you. We are not evaluating production quality - we want to hear how you communicate and learn a bit about your experience in your own words. Paid Screening Task Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test ($20 USD): We will send you a schematic of an existing circuit board and a component datasheet. Using those references, draw a schematic (in KiCad, by hand, or in any tool you prefer) showing how to connect an MCP23017 I2C GPIO expander to an ESP32-S3's I2C bus with 4 tactile button inputs, proper pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, and debounce capacitors. Include I2C device addressing. This should take 30-60 minutes for someone comfortable with I2C and basic schematic capture. We are evaluating: correctness of the circuit, understanding of I2C fundamentals, attention to detail (pull-ups, decoupling, addressing), and clarity of the schematic. Everyone who completes the test will be paid regardless of whether we hire them. ________________________________________ About Us We are a small US-based technology company building software and hardware products for a specialized professional market. Our software platform is in active development. The hardware products are IoT accessories that connect to our software platform via WiFi/MQTT. We are a small team that values clear communication, careful work, and people who take ownership of their area. This is a real company building real products. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not someone looking for a quick gig. ________________________________________ To Apply Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume, PCB examples (if any), and your brief message. We will respond to all qualified applicants within 3–5 business days.

description: Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you. Most clients come from DM conversations. We are already flooding the market with content across Instagram, Facebook , TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X, and the volume of inbound + outbound conversations is only going up. I have a full Content Operating System and A-Player closers. Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is: Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results. You will: - Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others). - On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when the existing flows and automations have done their part and a human is needed. - Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team. - Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results. - Be measured on: --> Conversations started --> Calls booked --> Show-up rate --> Sales from your sets This is appointment setting, not closing. What You’ll Actually Do (Daily): - Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads). - Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training. - Start DMs with warm leads, for example: --> People who comment with clear pain/interest --> Story viewers/voters (when handed to you) --> Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you - Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit). - Handle basic objections at the DM level (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call. - Book calls on the correct calendar, with all required notes. - Keep your own simple tracking updated so we always know: - Who you talked to - Who booked a call from your DMs - Who showed up - Which of those calls became paying clients (you’ll see this from our CRM for commissions) - Who bought (for commissions) - Follow up on old leads consistently (you will not “forget” people). - Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (e.g. “how do I work with you?”) and move those people into DMs. (Low-level comment engagement is handled by a VA, not by you.) - Work closely with me + my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field. You will not be responsible for content creation, editing, or generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls. Who This Is For: You’re a fit if: - You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs don’t drain you; you enjoy them. - Written English is 9/10+. You can sound natural, not robotic. - You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if for coaches/consultants/fitness). - You can show proof – numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies – that you’ve actually booked calls and driven revenue before. - You’re hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a tiny fixed salary. - You like being measured. Numbers don’t scare you. - You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with my time (Dubai) and US/Europe prospects. - You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays. Content + attention won’t stop on weekends. Nice-to-have (but not required): - Certificates in appointment setting / sales (e.g. setter/closer programs). If you have them, send them – they’re a plus, not a must. This is NOT for you if: - You’re scared of rejection or “pushback” in DMs. - You want to “learn sales someday” but have zero reps and zero proof. - You need someone to tell you every minute what to do. - You’re just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days. Compensation: This is performance-driven. - Base: $200–$300/month (depending on experience) - Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set --> Our programs are €3,500–€20,000 --> Even at the low end, 3–5% is ~$110–$300+ per sale - Realistic OTE once ramped: --> 15–25+ calls booked/month, --> 30–40% close rate by our closers, You can make $800–$1,800+ / month once you’re dialed in. There is no cap. If you blow it up, you earn more. Simple. Schedule: - Approx. 35–40 hours/week spread across: --> Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed) --> Sun: lighter check-ins + follow-ups You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever.” Minimum Requirements: - At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS, or similar). - Very strong written English (we will test this). - Stable internet + backup (data/second connection), and a quiet place to work. - Comfortable using: --> Instagram / Facebook / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs --> Google Sheets / basic CRM --> Loom / Zoom for training - Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them. How to Apply (Follow Instructions Exactly): 1. Subject line / OnlineJobs message title: A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name] 2. In your message, include short, direct answers to: a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences). b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer? c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you. d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here? e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun. f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs: - Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (e.g. “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”), - Any certificates in setting/sales you have (optional but a big plus). 3. OPTIONAL (big plus): Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you: -> Introduce yourself -> Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call -> Explain why you’re the best choice for this role Any generic “dear sir” or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I’m only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term. If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

Monitor supplier performance: shipping times, defect rates, stock availability, and reliability - Identify and resolve stockouts, fulfillment delays, and quality issues quickly - Handle multi-currency cost tracking and understand the impact of FX on our margins - Build and improve internal processes and systems to manage the supply chain at high volume - Work directly with the CEO on sourcing strategy, cost optimization, and scaling decisions - Take ownership and think proactively — anticipate problems instead of reacting to them HARD REQUIREMENTS - Proven experience managing supply chain or supplier operations for a high-volume e-commerce or dropshipping business — this is not a role for beginners - You are used to working with large revenues, large order volumes, and large SKU catalogs (3,000+ SKUs) - Experience managing multiple suppliers / Chinese agents at the same time - A strong, direct communicator and hard negotiator — you are comfortable pushing back, questioning charges, and holding suppliers accountable - Strong with numbers — you can spot pricing errors instantly, calculate margin impact, and reconcile invoices accurately - Highly organized and detail-oriented — nothing slips through the cracks - Analytical, proactive, and able to make decisions independently - Comfortable working directly with the CEO in a fast-moving environment - Strong written English NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED) - Experience with European dropshipping markets - Familiarity with Shopify, supplier portals, and fulfillment systems - Experience building spreadsheets / systems for cost tracking and supplier management WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU - Full-time remote role - Direct collaboration with the CEO - High ownership and real impact on company profitability - Opportunity to grow into a senior operations or supply chain lead role - Long-term position inside a fast-growing e-commerce business HOW TO APPLY To apply, send us: - Your resume - A short summary (3–5 sentences) of your experience — include how many suppliers, how many SKUs, and what order/revenue volume you managed - job_title: Top-Tier Real Estate Cold Caller / Acquisitions Setter (US Real Estate) — Night Shift
description: Type: Full-time or Part-time (start ~30 hrs/week, can grow) Schedule: US business/evening hours — this is a night shift in PH time Pay: Competitive base (USD) + uncapped per-appointment and per-deal bonuses Location: Remote (Philippines), work-from-home Read this whole post carefully — we only want the top 1% of callers, and the application instructions at the bottom will filter out everyone who didn't. We're a US real estate acquisitions company that buys houses for cash nationwide. We run high-volume outbound calling every day, and the phone is what d ---------- whether our closers get fed or the pipeline goes dry. We're not looking for someone to just "make dials." We're looking for a phone operator who understands that the cold caller is the closer's most important teammate. Our closers have done over half a billion dollars in sales over the phone. Your job is to put motivated home sellers in front of them. We measure everything. Callers who book appointments that show up and close get more leads, better lists, and more money. Callers who just ring dead air and clock out get cut. The setters we love treat every conversation like a live deal and every objection like a door, not a wall. THE ROLE You'll own the top of the funnel for our acquisitions team — calling skip-traced seller data, getting homeowners talking, uncovering real motivation, and locking qualified appointments our closers can turn into contracts. Three pillars to this role: 1. Conversations. You can stay sharp on call 300 like you were on call 3. Rejection doesn't rattle you, volume doesn't burn you out, and you genuinely enjoy talking to strangers — because you're good at it. 2. Discovery & rapport. Anyone can read a script. You get sellers to actually open up — why they're really selling, the situation behind it, the timeline, the number in their head. You listen more than you talk and you hear what they're not saying. 3. Setting. You don't just "generate interest" — you lock the appointment. You qualify hard (motivation, equity, timeline, condition), handle the objection before it lands, and set appointments that actually show up and close. A no-show is a loss, and you know it. The callers who win can do all three: grind the dials, build trust fast, and close for the next step. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING - Running a power dialer through skip-traced seller lists — measured on contacts and appointments set, not vanity dial counts - Holding real conversations with US homeowners and uncovering motivation, timeline, condition, and price expectations - Qualifying leads against our buy box — knowing a real motivated seller from a tire-kicker - Setting qualified appointments directly onto our closers' calendars - Handling objections and gatekeepers calmly ("I'm not interested," "what's your offer," "how'd you get my number") - Logging every single call accurately in the CRM — if it's not logged right, it didn't happen - Working callbacks fast — a seller who calls back is the hottest lead you'll get - Hitting daily targets across set call windows (we manage to dials/hr, contacts/hr, and appointments set) - Communicating with the team on Slack about what's landing and what's not WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Phone skills: - 2+ years of high-volume outbound — US real estate acquisitions/wholesaling strongly preferred, or hard B2C cold calling that actually converted - Rejection-proof and high-energy through a full shift — call 300 sounds like call 3 - Excellent, clear, easy-to-understand spoken English — you're talking to US homeowners all day and they need to trust you instantly - You sound like a human having a conversation, not someone reading a script Sales & discovery: - You build rapport in the first 15 seconds and get past the wall - Real objection-handling — a calm, practiced answer to every common "no," and you know a real objection from a brush-off - Motivation discovery — you dig for the why behind the sale and the true timeline and number - Disciplined qualifying — you don't waste a closer's calendar on a weak lead, and you don't kill a strong one with a bad set Setup & process (non-negotiable): - Noise-canceling headset, a quiet home office, and reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection - Backup power (UPS/generator) — brownouts can't take you offline mid-shift - Comfortable on a power/predictive dialer (BatchDialer, Mojo, CallTools, or similar) - CRM discipline — you disposition every call, accurately, in real time - Self-directed and coachable — we give you the script, the data, and the windows; you bring the effort and the reps - Able to work US hours (night shift in the Philippines) consistently BONUS POINTS - US real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispo experience - You've set appointments for high-ticket closers and understand the hand-off - You can listen back to a call and explain exactly why it went sideways and how you'd run it again - You study the craft — you steal from the best closers you know PAY & GROWTH - Base (USD) + uncapped bonuses per appointment set and per deal closed — your income scales with your results - Start ~30 hrs/week, with a clear path to full-time and more responsibility for top performers - We cover the dialer, the data/lists, the CRM, the scripts, and ongoing coaching HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we skip incomplete applications) Start your application with the word "MOTIVATED" at the very top so we know you actually read this. Applications without it get deleted. Then send us: 1. A call recording — a real cold call or a realistic mock call, 2–5 minutes. This is the most important thing. We want to hear your tone, your discovery, and how you handle a "no." Raw audio is fine. 2. Your numbers — dials, conversations, appointments set, conversion/close rate. Be honest about where you are. 3. One appointment or deal you're proud of — 3–4 sentences on the situation and why you locked it. 4. How you'd respond to "I'm not interested" (or "just send me a cash offer") — write it exactly the way you'd say it on the phone. 5. Your setup — internet speed (run a speed test), backup internet/power, headset, dialer experience, and your work environment. 6. Your expected rate — base hourly + what you'd want per appointment set and per deal closed. 7. Availability — hours per week and the earliest you can start (confirm you can work US night-shift hours).

title: Senior UGC Video Editor (Meta Ads) + B-Roll Sourcing + AI Generation
job_title: Senior UGC Video Editor (Meta Ads) + B-Roll Sourcing + AI Generation
description: We're a performance marketing agency running paid social for DTC brands across supplements, beauty, real estate, and lifestyle verticals. We spend serious money on Meta every month and creative is the lever that d ---------- whether accounts scale or stall. We're not looking for someone to just "cut videos" — we're looking for a creative partner who understands that on Meta, the editor is the media buyer's most important teammate. We test creative aggressively. Winners get scaled, losers get killed, and we iterate weekly. The editors we love are the ones who treat every ad like a hypothesis and every variant like a data point. THE ROLE You'll own the post-production pipeline for multiple brands. That means taking raw UGC footage, creator deliverables, product shots, sourced B-roll, and AI-generated assets and turning them into ad variants that print money on Meta. Three pillars to this role: 1. Editing. You can cut a UGC ad in your sleep — hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, the works. 2. Sourcing B-roll. A huge part of making UGC ads work is finding the right supporting footage. That means knowing where to pull stock clips, digging through Pinterest and TikTok for reference and inspiration, finding free-use clips on YouTube, scraping competitor ads fro ---------- ta ad library, and knowing which clips are licensed for commercial use vs. which will get us in trouble. Half the battle is taste — knowing the exact shot that lands the message — and the other half is research speed. 3. Generating B-roll and A-roll with AI. When sourced footage doesn't exist or doesn't fit, you generate it. If we need a shot of a woman pouring coffee at 6am with golden hour lighting and the sourced clips look generic, you should be able to generate that in Higgsfield or Flow inside an hour and have it cut into the edit by end of day. The editors who win in 2026 are the ones who can move fluidly between all three: cut creator UGC, source perfect supporting clips, and generate the impossible shots. That's what we're hiring for. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING - Editing 5–15 ad variants per week across multiple brands - Cutting hooks (we usually test 3–5 hook variants per concept, same body) - Pacing edits for direct response — fast cuts, motion, pattern interrupts, captioned throughout - Sourcing B-roll from stock libraries, social platforms, and free archives — and knowing what's legally clear to use - Building reference boards fro ---------- ta ad library, competitor ads, and viral organic content - Generating A-roll talking-head clips when we need spokesperson angles we don't have footage for - Creating AI B-roll: lifestyle shots, product close-ups, transformations, before/afters, environmental context - Building character-consistent AI footage when we're running a series or recurring "spokesperson" - Mixing UGC creator footage with sourced clips and AI-generated supplementary footage seamlessly - Adding captions (burned-in, branded styling), sound design, music, SFX - Versioning ads for different placements (Reels, Feed, Stories) and aspect ratios - Communicating async via Slack/Loom with the media buyer on what's working and what's not WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Editing chops: - 2+ years editing DTC/UGC ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok - Portfolio with examples we can verify ran as paid ads (bonus if you have performance data) - Native fluency in Premiere, CapCut, or DaVinci — we don't care which, just be fast - Strong instinct for direct response: you know why a 0.8 second hook beats a 2 second one, you understand thumb-stop ratio, and you've watched enough Meta ad library to recognize patterns - Caption and subtitle work that doesn't look like default CapCut - Sound design that doesn't sound stock (royalty-free music is fine, lazy music choice is not) B-roll sourcing skills: - Active accounts or familiarity with Storyblocks, Artgrid, Envato, Motion Array, Pexels, Pixabay, or similar - You know how to search efficiently — you don't burn 2 hours looking for the right clip - You understand commercial licensing basics (what's safe, what's not, when in doubt how to verify) - You have a system for saving and organizing reference inspiration (Pinterest boards, Notion, Eagle, Milanote — whatever works) - You can pull fro ---------- ta ad library and TikTok creative center to inform your edits and find inspiration footage AI generation experience: - Hands-on production experience with at least 2 of: Higgsfield (Soul, DoP, character training), Google Flow / Veo 3, Kling, Runway, Sora, Nano Banana - You've solved real problems with these tools — character consistency across clips, lip sync, motion control, prompt engineering for specific aesthetics - You understand the failure modes (warped hands, weird physics, identity drift) and how to work around them - You have a perspective on which tool to reach for when — not just "I use whatever" Process: - Fast async communication - Comfortable working from briefs, scripts, and reference ads - Self-directed — we'll give you direction and references, but you should bring ideas - Honest when something isn't working BONUS POINTS - Supplement, beauty, or health DTC experience - You've reverse-engineered winning ads fro ---------- ta ad library and can articulate why they work - Familiarity with creative testing frameworks (hook-body-CTA structure, modular variants) - You've used Higgsfield Soul for character consistency or trained custom characters - ElevenLabs or similar AI voice work - Motion graphics chops (After Effects, or template-based motion in CapCut) - You follow people like Ed (Ad Burnouts), Barrett, Nick Shackelford, or have your own creative inspiration sources LOGISTICS - Type: Contract, with a clear path to ongoing retainer for the right person - Hours: Start at ~15–25 hrs/week, can grow - Location: Remote, async-friendly. Some overlap with PST hours preferred but not required - Rate: Tell us yours. We pay competitively for editors who can actually do all three sides of this (UGC editing + B-roll sourcing + AI generation is rare — we know that) - Tools we'll cover: AI generation tool subscriptions and stock library access if you don't already have them HOW TO APPLY Applications missing any of these get skipped: 1. Portfolio link — Vimeo, personal site, ---------- , Google Drive folder. We want to see DTC/UGC ads, not wedding videos or short films. 2. 2–3 AI-generated clips you've made — A-roll, B-roll, character work, whatever shows your range. Raw clips are fine. Tell us which tool and what the prompt/process was. 3. One ad you didn't make but love — link it and tell us in 3–4 sentences why it works. This tells us how you think. 4. Your B-roll sourcing stack — which stock libraries you have access to, where else you pull from, and your process for finding the right clip fast. 5. Your AI stack — which tools you use, which you'd reach for first, and one limitation of your favorite tool. 6. Your rate — hourly or per-edit, both fine. Be honest about where you are. 7. Availability — hours per week, time zone, when you can start.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / E2B / Vercel Platforms)
job_title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / E2B / Vercel Platforms)
description: We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer to help us launch MythOS Pro, an AI-powered operating system for local service businesses (barbershops, salons, restaurants). It's a full platform: CRM, booking/calendar, payments, inventory, a workforce module, an AI agent (Mylo) that runs across all of it, and a website builder. You'll work directly with the founder and grow into a core engineering role as we get launch-ready. Strong English communication required. Priority #1 — Website Builder (the immediate need): Our builder lets a customer import their GitHub repo, edit their Next.js site inside our platform, then push to main, which triggers an automatic Vercel redeploy so their live site updates. We need this pipeline rock-solid: Fix reliability issues with our E2B sandbox (sandboxes sometimes fail to load / dev server doesn't bind correctly on port 3000). Reference: e2b-dev/fragments. Build a clean GitHub repo import flow: clone repo into the sandbox (sandbox.git.clone), npm install, boot the Next.js dev server, expose the preview URL into our editor iframe. Implement edit ? commit ? push-to-main back to the customer's GitHub repo via the GitHub App (installation token). Wire the push to trigger Vercel auto-redeploy, with each customer's site served on their own subdomain via Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant). Help us finish setting this up. Sandbox lifecycle management: create, auto-pause on idle, resume on edit, kill on session end, with cost controls. Beyond the builder, there's a deep backlog across the whole platform — CRM, booking, payments integrations, inventory, the workforce module, and Mylo's agent capabilities. We want someone who can own significant pieces of the product and help drive us to launch. Our stack: Frontend/API surface (mythOS-pro): Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind, deployed on Vercel. Agent runtime (mythos-claw): a custom Rust runtime that powers our Mylo agent — built on a fork of NEAR AI's IronClaw, blended with OpenClaw, Hermes, GoClaw, and other components. Runs as a long-running service on Google Cloud Run (Postgres/Neon, Redis/Upstash, embedded Hermes worker, Gemini integration). Other: GitHub App integration, E2B sandboxes, Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant), Claude API, Pinecone vector search. The two runtimes communicate over HTTP — mythOS-pro is the public-facing surface, mythos-claw is the brain. Must have: Deep Next.js App Router + TypeScript experience and the ability to debug deployment/infra issues independently (Cloud Run, Vercel, sandboxed dev environments). Strong bonus / what sets you apart: Rust experience and comfort working in an agent runtime — we'd love someone who can contribute to mythos-claw itself, not just the Next.js surface.

We want proper Google Ads and feed architecture. The immediate focus is Google Ads, Shopping, PMax, Merchant Centre, and Simprosys. Other channels may follow later if the work goes well. Ideal Candidate * Experience managing Shopify stores with 300-1000+ SKUs * Strong Google Shopping and Performance Max experience * Deep understanding of Google Merchant Centre * Simprosys experience preferred * Comfortable working with margin-based segmentation * Understands custom labels and feed optimisation * Able to diagnose why some SKUs get low or no impressions * Experience expanding Google Ads accounts into additional countries is a bonus * Data-driven, commercially minded, and able to execute without constant hand-holding This role is not suitable if your background is mainly lead generation or Meta Ads only. title: Growth Marketer
description: What you build matters more than what you call yourself. A short pitch for who this is: You're the person already spending time in WordPress threads, dev subreddits, and indie-hacker corners. Not because it's a job. Because you find it interesting. You answer questions because answering questions is how you think. You don't run marketing through scheduling tools and call it a strategy. You read replies. You notice tone. You know which mod will nuke a link and which one will let it through if the comment actually helps. You've sent cold email s that got real responses, and you can explain why those ones worked. ABOUT SGEN SGEN's product is solid. The voice is dialed. Docs are clean. What's missing: a person who's in the room when WordPress users are venting, comparing options, asking the question that SGEN can answer. When somebody posts at 1 AM about a plugin conflict that just nuked a client site, there's no SGEN reply in that thread. When an agency owner asks Hacker News for a serious WordPress alternative, no one from our side shows up. When a sandbox user signs up and goes quiet for two weeks, nothing reaches out. That's the work. Daily presence — in communities, inboxes, and the funnel — done by someone who treats it as a craft, not a queue. WHO FITS You're patient with people and impatient with bad writing. You'd rather post one thoughtful reply than five generic ones. You think "automate the outreach" usually translates to "stop caring about the person on the other end." You can read a thread and feel where the conversation is heading before it gets there. You know community work runs on consistency, not bursts. You're prepared to be in the same places for months before they trust you. HAVE A REAL TAKE ON WORDPRESS Doesn't matter which way. Pro, anti, complicated — all fine. What matters: you've used it enough to talk about it without faking. You can describe what people love about it and where it breaks down. When you bring SGEN into a conversation, it's because the conversation called for it — not because you had a quota. People in those communities can tell the difference between somebody who knows the ecosystem and somebody running a script. STEADY WHEN THINGS GET NOISY Reddit will push back. Hacker News will be skeptical. Somebody will accuse SGEN of being vaporware, or worse. You don't fight it. You don't flood the thread with a defense. You answer once, calmly, with substance. Then you let the comment do its work. You've been around online long enough to know when a remark deserves a reply and when it deserves to drift. THE ACTUAL WORK Communities. Reddit (WP-adjacent and agency-adjacent subs), Hacker News, IndieHackers, dev-focused ---------- s and Slack groups. Show up where the audience already is. Reply with substance. Build a profile that earns its own credibility — not just SGEN's. Inbox. Email sequences for sandbox users, drip flows for trial accounts that stalled, founder-style outreach to agencies worth a direct ask. Cadence and segmentation are your call. Voice support is there when you want it. Funnel. Watch the signup path, find where it breaks, write the experiment, ship it, report back without the gloss. Tag every signup with first-touch source so the team knows what's actually working. Monthly read-out. Plain English. What moved, what didn't, what you're trying next. No vanity slide decks. WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR - English that reads native. US/UK readers shouldn't catch a translation feel. SGEN talks to a Western technical audience. Real community track record. Two-plus years of being a regular somewhere — posting, replying, helping. We'll look at your account. - Email that converted. Sequences you wrote, what you learned, what you'd change. Open and reply rates if you have them. - Working knowledge of WordPress. You don't need to be a developer. You need to be able to talk to its users without sounding like an outsider. - A preference for showing up over automating. Tools help eventually. Presence wins first. - Self-editing. You re-read before you post. You delete the line that sounds salesy. You don't ship the first draft. PROBABLY IF YOU… - You have a Reddit account with karma in places that aren't easy to game. - You've written a cold email that got a real reply and you can explain why. - You can spot an AI-written marketing email from the first sentence. - "Growth hacking" is a phrase you mostly roll your eyes at. - You've spent unpaid hours helping people online because the question was interesting. - You know which subs tolerate a link and which will incinerate it. WHAT THIS ISN’T It isn't running a content mill. It isn't standing up an automation stack and calling that strategy. It isn't copy-pasting the same post across five channels. It isn't outsourcing presence to scheduling tools. It's a person doing the work, in public, every week. WHY IT MATTERS Communities d ---------- trust slowly, then permanently. If SGEN shows up in the right threads with real answers, over months, that trust compounds into word-of-mouth no ad campaign can buy. If SGEN doesn't show up at all, every later marketing dollar will be working uphill against absence. The right hire here makes SGEN feel present. The wrong hire here doesn't. COMPENSATION $600-$650 USD per month SCHEDULE - 8 hour shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00AM to 4:00PM Philippine Time. - Minimal overtime during weekdays and weekends will be expected as part of salary SGEN is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other basis protected by law.
