title: ClickUp Project Manager (Websites and SEO)
description: # Full-Time Project Manager for Web Design and SEO Agency ## About Frisco Web Agency Frisco Web Agency is a growing web design and digital marketing agency based in Frisco, Texas. Our primary service is designing and developing custom websites for service-based businesses. We also manage ongoing Search Engine Optimization campaigns and occasionally take on other digital projects. We are currently a small team of three: * Christopher Potter — Owner * Rocky Diana — Web Developer * Melissa Saldana — Administrative Support We are looking for a full-time Project Manager who can take ownership of our client projects, organize our fulfillment process, and keep everything moving forward without requiring constant direction. ## The Main Outcome of This Role The most important responsibility of this position is simple: **Make sure every project continues moving forward and is completed on time—or preferably ahead of schedule.** As the owner, Christopher needs to focus more of his time on marketing, sales, strategy, and growing the company. Right now, managing multiple active projects can pull him away from those responsibilities. Your role will be to take ownership of the day-to-day management of our fulfillment. You will need to know: * Where every project currently stands * What has already been completed * What still needs to be completed * Who is responsible for each task * What is due next * What is falling behind * What information we are waiting on * What the client needs to know * What could prevent us fro ---------- eting a deadline We do not want someone who only updates tasks after being told what to do. We need someone who thinks ahead, identifies problems early, communicates clearly, and actively pushes projects toward completion every day. ## Primary Responsibilities ### Manage Website Projects Most of your work will involve managing custom website design and development projects. You will be responsible for: * Setting up and organizing projects in ClickUp * Reviewing each active project every day * Creating and assigning tasks * Confirming that tasks have clear descriptions, deadlines, and owners * Following up with tea ---------- mbers about incomplete or overdue work * Identifying the next steps before the current steps are completed * Coordinating design, content, development, revisions, quality assurance, and launch * Gathering missing information and materials from clients * Communicating project updates to clients * Preventing projects from becoming stalled * Keeping projects on schedule and pushing for early completion * Escalating problems before they become emergencies ### Manage SEO Campaigns Website projects will be the primary responsibility, but you will also help manage ongoing SEO campaigns. This may include: * Organizing monthly SEO deliverables in ClickUp * Confirming that assigned SEO work is completed * Coordinating content, website updates, keyword research, on-page optimization, and reporting * Tracking recurring monthly responsibilities * Preparing client updates * Following up on missing approvals or information * Making sure monthly deliverables do not get overlooked You do not need to be an advanced SEO strategist, but you should be willing to learn our process and understand enough to manage the work effectively. ### Communicate With Clients You will become one of the main points of contact for active client projects. Communication may take place through: * Email * ClickUp * Google Meet * Internal tea ---------- ssages You will be responsible for: * Providing clear and proactive updates * Asking clients for missing content, feedback, approvals, or access * Explaining what is happening next * Following up when a client has not responded * Setting realistic expectations * Keeping communication professional, organized, and easy to understand * Making sure clients do not have to ask us repeatedly for updates Clients should feel that their project is organized, actively managed, and moving forward. ### Communicate With the Team You will communicate with our team throughout the workday, Monday through Friday. This includes: * Reviewing progress with tea ---------- mbers * Following up on tasks * Answering project-related questions * Clarifying priorities * Identifying blockers * Confirming deadlines * Making sure tea ---------- mbers understand what is expected * Communicating important client feedback * Helping the team determine what should be worked on next You must be comfortable holding people accountable respectfully and directly. ### Own and Improve ClickUp ClickUp is the primary project management system used by Frisco Web Agency. You will be expected to: * Keep ClickUp accurate and up to date * Make sure tasks are assigned correctly * Maintain deadlines, statuses, dependencies, and priorities * Ensure task descriptions contain enough information for the work to be completed * Keep client and internal communication organized * Improve dashboards, templates, automations, and workflows * Identify areas where ClickUp is becoming confusing or inefficient * Recommend and implement improvements * Make ClickUp a reliable source of truth for the entire company At any time, we should be able to open ClickUp and quickly understand the status of every project. ### Maintain Company Playbooks We use the Buy Back Your Time playbook method to document how work should be completed. You will help: * Create playbooks for repeatable processes * Update playbooks when our processes change * Organize instructions, videos, links, and resources * Identify missing documentation * Make sure tea ---------- mbers follow the documented process * Improve processes based on problems that occur during fulfillment Our goal is to build a company that does not depend on information being stored only in one person’s head. ## What We Are Looking For The right person for this role is: * Highly organized * Proactive * Dependable * Detail-oriented * Comfortable following up with people * Able to communicate professionally with clients * Able to manage several projects at the same time * Calm when priorities change * Willing to take ownership of outcomes * Able to think several steps ahead * Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear * Able to make decisions without needing constant approval * Interested in improving systems and processes * Consistent with communication * Able to identify potential delays before deadlines are missed You should naturally notice when something has not been completed and take action without waiting to be reminded. ## This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You: * Wait for someone to tell you every next step * Avoid difficult conversations or follow-ups * Regularly forget details * Are uncomfortable holding others accountable * Only update ClickUp when someone reminds you * Become overwhelmed when managing several projects * Disappear during your working hours * Allow unanswered questions to sit unresolved * Assume that someone else will take responsibility * Communicate vaguely or leave people uncertain * Prefer completing isolated tasks instead of owning the overall outcome ## Required Qualifications * Previous experience in project management, operations, or client coordination * Experience using ClickUp or a similar project management platform * Strong written and spoken English * Strong organizational and time-management skills * Experience communicating with clients through email and meetings * Reliable computer and internet connection * Ability to work independently * Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects * Ability to document and improve processes * Willingness to learn website development and SEO fulfillment processes Experience working for a web design, marketing, SEO, or digital agency is strongly preferred. ## Working Hours and Availability This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. You must be available for a daily meeting with Christopher at: **8:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday** Because this is a communication-heavy role, you must also be responsive and available during your agreed working hours. Your working schedule will be established so that you have enough overlap with Christopher, the team, and our clients. This is not a position where you can complete all your work without communicating with the team. Active communication throughout the workweek is an essential part of the job. ## Trial Period and Payment This position will begin with a 90-day trial period. During the trial period, we will evaluate: * Reliability * Communication * Organization * Ownership * Ability to manage deadlines * ClickUp management * Client communication * Team coordination * Ability to keep projects moving * Overall fit with the company You will be paid every two weeks. You will complete each two-week work period and then receive payment for that completed period. **Starting compensation: [INSERT MONTHLY SALARY OR HOURLY RATE]** There is room for increased responsibility, compensation, and long-term growth as Frisco Web Agency grows. ## What Success Looks Like You will be successful in this role when: * Christopher no longer has to personally manage every project * Every project has a clear status, owner, deadline, and next step * Tea ---------- mbers know what they should be working on * Clients receive proactive communication * Delays are identified and addressed early * ClickUp is consistently accurate * Tasks do not disappear or remain forgotten * Projects are completed on time or ahead of schedule * Company processes are documented and continuously improved * You can clearly explain the status of every active project without confusion or uncertainty The long-term goal is for you to fully own project fulfillment so Christopher can focus on marketing, sales, leadership, and growing the business. ## How to Apply Please include the following information in your application: 1. A short introduction about yourself 2. Your previous project management experience 3. Your experience using ClickUp 4. Any experience managing website or SEO projects 5. An example of a project that was falling behind and how you moved it forward 6. Your approach to following up with a tea ---------- mber who repeatedly misses deadlines 7. Your internet speed and computer specifications 8. Confirmation that you can attend a daily meeting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time 9. Your expected monthly salary 10. A short video introduction explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position At the beginning of your application, include the words: **“I push projects forward.”** Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.

Specialist informed of ticket status, technical findings, and escalation needs DNS & Email Hosting Support * Assist clients with DNS record configuration in GoDaddy and Cloudflare * Troubleshoot and resolve SSL certificate issues, including expired certificates, mixed content warnings, and domain verification problems * Support clients using Rackspace Email and assist with migrating accounts to OpenSRS, including DNS setup, mailbox migration, and client coordination * Help clients configure Rackspace and OpenSRS email accounts into leading email applications including Outlook, Gmail, and mobile mail clients * Identify and escalate systemic email delivery or routing issues to vendors as needed Shopify Support * Troubleshoot and resolve Shopify storefront issues including theme layout problems, navigation, page content, section and block configuration, and checkout display issues * Assist clients with connecting custom domains to Shopify, including DNS configuration, SSL verification, and subdomain and redirect setup * Help clients with basic Shopify admin tasks including product setup, collections, metafields, and page content management * Escalate complex Shopify development requests — such as custom development, advanced Liquid logic, or API integrations — to a lead developer with full documentation Customer & Ticket Management * Interact with clients to provide timely support and information across all assigned channels * Manage the full ticket lifecycle: opening, assigning, monitoring, escalating, and resolving support tickets * Troubleshoot and resolve general account and access issues, including password resets, account lockouts, and client inquiries not handled by a dedicated support section * Maintain accurate records of client interactions, including details of inquiries, complaints, and actions taken * Escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate team member or vendor partner with thorough documentation * Fulfill all service level standards for response time and quality Knowledge Management * Develop and maintain a library of support articles, how-to guides, and best practices * Flag outdated or inaccurate articles and update them to reflect current products and procedures * Document troubleshooting patterns and contribute new content that reduces repeat ticket volume AI-Assisted Workflows * Incorporate AI tools into daily support workflows to improve response quality, efficiency, and consistency * Use AI to assist with code troubleshooting, research, documentation, and client communications — always verifying AI-generated output before applying it to live systems * Stay current on emerging AI tools and recommend new applications that benefit the support team WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You'll need: * Practical experience troubleshooting and updating websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, including CMS-driven sites — content updates, layout fixes, template edits, and moderately complex code changes * Strong understanding of website hosting, domains, and DNS, including the ability to create, update, troubleshoot, and migrate records such as A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC * Experience troubleshooting email setup and delivery issues, including mailbox configuration, configuring email into client applications, DNS-related email problems, and basic deliverability issues * Familiarity with FTP/SFTP, hosting control panels, CMS admin tools, browser developer tools, and basic server resources for investigating and resolving issues * Comfortable using AI tools to assist with technical troubleshooting, code review, research, documentation, and rewriting client replies — with good judgment about verifying recommendations before applying them * Ability to investigate technical problems independently, review code and configurations thoroughly, document findings clearly, and balance speed with accuracy on live systems * Strong English communication skills — written and verbal — including clear, professional client-facing responses and the ability to join client calls when needed * Availability during U.S. business hours with real-time responsiveness throughout the shift You'll stand out if you have: * Shopify experience, including theme editing (Liquid, CSS, JavaScript), custom domain and DNS setup, app troubleshooting, and Shopify admin support * Experience with Rackspace Email and/or OpenSRS, including mailbox setup, client configuration, deliverability troubleshooting, and email account migration * Experience with GoDaddy for domain management, DNS configuration, and registrar-level settings * Experience using FreshDesk or a comparable help desk/ticketing platform * Experience with custom CMS platforms, WordPress, or other website management systems * Experience writing knowledge base articles, technical documentation, or internal troubleshooting guides * Experience working with U.S.-based clients or companies * Familiarity with Git or other version-control workflows * Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Cloudflare Fundamentals, or Shopify Partner are helpful but not required BENEFITS * Competitive compensation with 13th month pay (USD or PHP) * Long-term engagement with a people-first U.S. agency * Consistent schedule: Monday through Friday, U.S. business hours * We manufacture and distribute industrial, hydraulic, and metal hose assemblies and associated components serving customers across manufacturing, construction, automotive, aerospace, and beyond. You will work in TrulinX ERP to enter and process orders, send order acknowledgements from our shared sales@ email account, and keep the queue moving cleanly throughout your shift. Your inside sales teammates in Cleveland are counting on the dashboard being worked accurately and on time so they can focus on customers. Precision, reliability, and ownership of your queue are what this role is built on. What You'll Do • Monitor and process orders from the inside sales team's shared order entry dashboard throughout your shift • Enter and manage sales orders accurately in TrulinX ERP, following established procedures and data standards • Send order acknowledgements to customers from the shared sales@ email account promptly upon order entry • Review orders for completeness and accuracy before processing — flag discrepancies or missing information to the appropriate inside sales tea ---------- mber • Maintain organized records of processed orders, acknowledgements sent, and any exceptions or holds • Communicate proactively with the US-based inside sales team regarding queue status, order questions, or processing delays • Support process improvement by identifying recurring order entry issues or dashboard workflow gaps Qualifications • 2+ years of experience in order entry, data entry, inside sales support, or a related back-office role • Experience working with an ERP system is strongly preferred; clear and professional in email correspondence • Self-motivated and reliable; able to manage and prioritize a task queue independently with minimal supervision • Experienced working remotely with a US-based team; comfortable with asynchronous communication and early morning Philippine Standard Time shifts • Stable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated, distraction-free home workspace • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace; comfortable learning new software quickly • Experience in industrial distribution, manufacturing, or a related sector is a plus, but not required Schedule • Full-time, Monday–Friday • This is a night shift role based on Philippine Standard Time: 8:00 PM – 4:30 AM PHT, corresponding to 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM US Eastern Time • This schedule is required to maintain full overlap with our Cleveland-based inside sales team during US business hours — please apply only if you are able and willing to work these hours consistently Compensation & Benefits We structure our compensation for Philippines-based tea ---------- mbers to be competitive, transparent, and compliant with Philippine labor law: • Base salary: $7.00 – $9.00 USD per hour, paid on a salaried basis (rate commensurate with experience) • Monthly health benefit allowance paid in addition to base salary to support local health coverage • Monthly technology/equipment allowance paid in addition to base salary for home office and connectivity needs • 13th month pay — paid in compliance with Philippine law and scaled with company performance and your tenure with TCH • Paid time off and holidays • A supportive, stable remote work environment with an established Philippines-based team and a company that is actively growing We have built a strong remote team in the Philippines and we are intentional about how we support and compensate them. description: Project Overview:?I am a livestreaming musician looking for a talented 3D Artist / Motion Designer to build a series of highly atmospheric virtual stages. These will serve as pre-rendered video backgrounds behind a physical green screen using Ecamm Live to broadcast weekly live virtual concerts. Since the performance changes and evolves each week, and new shows with different stage backgrounds are in production, the right candidate could be employed consistently for roughly 10 hours a week or more for the long-term. The core aesthetic for this project is a vast, eerie cathedral or ancient monastery (dark gothic architecture, towering arches, stained glass, dimly lit corridors). A central element of this stage will be a mystical, magical video projection integrated into the environment and a single performer playing guitar and keyboards integrated seamlessly into the virtual stage. Key Responsibilities: • 3D Environment Modeling: Design a grand, gothic cathedral or monastery interior featuring large pillars, stone textures, and dramatic architectural depth. • Virtual Screen Integration: Seamlessly embed a 16:9 aspect ratio projection area into the cathedral background that plays video files provided by me. The screen should be styled as a magical, mystical projection (e.g., hovering ethereal mist, a magical energy field, or glowing ancient runes) rather than a modern LED wall. • Multi-Angle Perspective: Distort and skew the embedded 16:9 video playback window so it realistically matches the perspective and depth of a few different camera angles focused on the performer. • Lighting & Animation: Create eerie, moody light shows (flickering candlelight, moonlight piercing through stained glass, pulsing low-light columns, and lasers) looped to a steady tempo. • Atmospheric Visual Effects (VFX): Integrate thick volumetric stage fog, floating dust motes/particles, and realistic light shafts to create a haunting sense of scale. • Seamless Rendering: Export perfectly looping video files with zero visible cuts or jumps upon looping. Required Skills and Qualifications: • Expertise in Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya or whatever software gets the job done. • Strong portfolio showcasing gothic, dark fantasy, or grand historical 3D environments. • Experience embedding external video textures/materials into a 3D environment with proper perspective warping. • Deep understanding of volumetric lighting, god rays, and atmospheric fog rendering. • Ability to structure the composition to leave a clear "performer pocket" in the center frame. Technical Deliverables: • Format: MP4 or MOV • Resolution: 1080p (16:9 aspect ratio). • Framerate: 30fps • Duration: 30-to-60-second seamless loops. Application Process & Screening Test To be considered for this position, please reply with the following information: • A link to your portfolio, ArtStation, or video reel highlighting your best dark fantasy, gothic, or realistic 3D environments. • Your preferred 3D creation software. ?? title: Client Growth Specialist

This person will also help shape scalable, automation-ready sales and customer success processes as the function grows. Cross-functional Collaboration - Work closely with marketing to align outreach with campaign activity and content calendars. - Support the development of sales enablement materials and client-facing talk tracks. Skills & Experience Required - 2 to 4 years in a customer success, account management, or inside sales role. - Proven track record managing a book of business and hitting conversion or retention targets. - Experience running outbound sales sequences (email , LinkedIn) and managing pipeline in a CRM. - Exceptional written English, natural, polished, and persuasive across email , social, and client-facing copy. AI tools may be used to support output, but candidates must be able to write well on their own. - Campaign management experience, with the ability to plan, execute, and report on multi-channel marketing or outreach campaigns end to end. - Comfortable thinking in systems — turning repeated sales, follow-up, and client success tasks into documented workflows, templates, and automations. - Strong verbal communicator, confident in customer-facing conversations and discovery calls. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, project-driven environment. - Organised, self-directed, and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Nice to Have - Experience in B2B consulting, professional services, SaaS, or technology industries. - Familiarity with the tools we use day-to-day: HubSpot (CRM, pipeline, workflows), NetSuite (client and account management), Notion and Microsoft 365. - Experience collaborating with marketing teams on integrated outreach campaigns. - Understanding of consultative selling and solution-based sales approaches. - Sales automation mindset, with an interest in building repeatable, scalable outreach and follow-up processes using CRM workflows, email sequences, task automation, and AI-supported tools. Hours & Growth Potential - Part-time contract role initially of 20 to 30 hours per week over a 3-month engagement, with potential to scale up to 40 hours per week as the workload grows. - 3-month initial contract with a clear path to a permanent, full-time position for the right person. - Starts at PHP250 per hour, with expected weekly earnings of PHP5,000 to PHP7,500 depending on hours, paid weekly, with room for negotiation based on experience. - Fully remote, with flexibility around working hours provided commitments are met and clients are well supported (clients are generally online AEST). - You'll work closely with Marketing Manager and Project Manager, who will help onboard you into our sales processes, tools, and client contexts. - This role provides scope to grow across both sales operations and broader client growth functions as you build capability and confidence. - Markited offers a growing, process-driven environment where capable contributors can expand their role over time. What Success Looks Like - Consistent growth in consultations booked and pipeline opportunities created. - High customer satisfaction and retention across managed accounts. - Regular, proactive customer engagement cadence maintained across all accounts. - Accurate, up-to-date CRM records and pipeline reporting. Application Process Candidates interested in applying should message on this platform or email their resume, a cover letter explaining their interest and qualifications for the role, and any samples of sales or customer-facing work (e.g. outreach email s, LinkedIn messages, case studies, or pipeline reports) to ---------- with the subject line: Sales Alchemist.

Qualifications Required * Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. * 5+ years of experience in project management, business analysis, or technology operations. * Experience working with software development teams. * Strong understanding of workflow design and business process improvement. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Advanced organizational and documentation skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Preferred * PMP, PMI-ACP, CBAP, or similar certification. * Experience with Jira, GitHub, Confluence, and ticketing systems. * Experience supporting operational and client-facing technology projects. * Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies. * Experience with process automation initiatives. Technical Skills * Jira * GitHub * Microsoft Office Suite * Google Workspace * Visio, Lucidchart, or similar workflow tools * Project Management Software * Reporting and Dashboard Tools Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Percentage of projects delivered on time. * Accuracy and completeness of requirements documentation. * Reduction in project rework and development defects. * Leadership approval rate of submitted deliverables. * Timeliness of project communications and follow-ups. * User acceptance testing success rate. * Stakeholder satisfaction scores. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description: ## Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager (Philippines-Based) ### About Us [Unicorn Buyers Agents (UBA)]( ---------- ) is Sydney’s premier boutique buyers agency for owner-occupiers and investors. Led by our Director, Dan Sofo, we help families, first-time buyers, and expats navigate one of the toughest, most competitive property markets in the world. We don't just find houses; we secure dreams. To date, we have bought over 200+ properties worth more than $460M+, with 72% of our deals secured completely off-market or pre-auction. Based in beautiful Paddington, Sydney, we hold a flawless reputation backed by 99+ five-star Google reviews. We are elite at what we do—now, we want our digital footprint to match. ### The Vision: Own Our Marketing, Shape Our Future We are not looking for a Virtual Assistant to check off a daily to-do list. We are looking for an independent, strategic partner who will become an integral part of our core team. Right now, Dan is driving the ideas. **The goal of this role is to change that.** We want a high performer who will take the raw clay of our brand, our data, and Dan's insights, and use them to shape the future of how UBA performs online. You will start by executing our current framework, but your ultimate mandate is to outgrow it—introducing new channels (like Substack), mastering emerging tech (like AEO), and independently driving our entire marketing roadmap without needing to be told what to do. If you want a job where you are a valued builder, not just a cog in a machine, this is your canvas. --- ### Position Details & Career Progression Roadmap We want to invest heavily in the right person. This position is structured to scale alongside your performance and commitment to the brand. * **Year 1 Commitment (Part-Time):** * **Hours:** 30 hours per week (6 hours/day), Monday to Friday * **Shift:** 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time (PHST) — aligning perfectly with high-stakes Sydney business hours. * **Remuneration:** $1,000 AUD per month * **Year 2 & Beyond (Guaranteed Career Progression):** * **Guaranteed Pay Increase:** Upon reaching your 1-year tenure milestone, you will receive a **guaranteed 10% pay increase**. * **Full-Time Upgrade:** At the 1-year mark, this role will **upgrade to a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**, allowing you to fully step into your role as our dedicated Marketing Driver. * **Location:** Remote (Philippines) --- ### Key Responsibilities & Future Growth Levers **1. Content Production & Social Media (Western Channels)** * Take Dan’s raw video footage from property inspections, market updates, and media appearances, and edit it into sharp, premium content. * Produce **3–4 long-form videos (1–3 minutes)** per week for YouTube and LinkedIn, and strategically repurpose them into highly engaging **short-form clips (30–60 seconds)**. * Manage, post, and optimize content across **Meta (Facebook /Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube**. **2. Copywriting & Email Marketing (Moving to Substack)** * Take our deep property insights and update the UBA website with regular, SEO-friendly blog posts. * Repurpose those insights into high-signal, engaging articles on **LinkedIn** to capture corporate professionals. * Manage and deploy our client and investor newsletters using **MailerLite**—with the immediate strategic goal of helping us launch, build, and monetize a premium presence on **Substack**. **3. Chinese Social Media Management (WeChat & Redbook)** * A massive growth lever for UBA is the Chinese-Australian and expat buyer market. You will take the lead on launching, managing, and growing our brand accounts on **WeChat Business** and **Xiaohongshu (Red/Redbook)** from scratch. **4. Performance Marketing & Future-Proofing (Google & AEO)** * Create, split-test, and optimize **Google Paid Ads** to continuously funnel high-quality discovery calls to Dan’s calendar. * **Drive our AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) efforts:** The future of search is changing. You will optimize our written and video content so that UBA is the definitive answer served by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini when affluent buyers search for Sydney property advice. --- ### Why a High Performer Should Join Us (What's In It For You) * **A Transparent Future:** We map out your growth from day one. Prove your value in year one, and unlock guaranteed higher pay and full-time security in year two. * **True Autonomy:** We don’t track every click; we track results, creativity, and initiative. You will have the freedom to test new ideas, fail fast, and build something you are proud of. * **Work Directly with a Thought Leader:** You will report directly to Dan Sofo. Dan is a hands-on, highly energetic Director who understands the value of elite marketing and will give you the resources and trust you need to succeed. * **An Unlimited Creative Sandbox:** Real estate is inherently visual and emotional. You'll be working with high-end Sydney property data, luxury property walkthroughs, and incredible client success stories. The "raw material" you get to work with is elite. --- ### Requirements & Qualifications * **Extreme Initiative:** If you are the type of person who waits for instructions, please do not apply. We want a self-starter who looks at our current marketing, identifies the gaps, and says, *"Hey Dan, I noticed we aren't optimizing for X, so I created a draft strategy for it."* * **Exceptional English & Aussie Nuance:** Our clients are buying multimillion-dollar properties. You must have flawless written and spoken English, and crucially, understand Australian cultural nuances, real estate terminology (auctions, off-market, passing-in), and tone. * **Elite Creativity:** You know how to edit videos so people actually watch past the first 3 seconds. You have an eye for sleek typography, clean transitions, and pacing. * **Technical & Forward-Thinking Stack:** Experienced in premium video editing tools, MailerLite (and ideally Substack), Google Ads Manager, Western/Chinese social media dashboards, and an understanding of modern AI search behavior (AEO/SEO). * **Reliability:** Strict availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM PHST. Must have a rock-solid internet connection and a reliable backup power solution. --- ### How to Apply We move fast. If you have the drive to turn Unicorn Buyers Agents into a digital content powerhouse and shape the future of our brand, please submit: 1. **Your updated resume.** 2. **A video introduction (1–2 minutes):** Tell Dan who you are and why you are the independent, strategic marketer he is looking for. 3. **Examples of your long-form writing work:** Since you will be taking over our website blogs, LinkedIn articles, and launching our Substack, please provide examples of long-form written content (e.g., articles, newsletters, or comprehensive blog posts) that demonstrate your ability to articulate complex ideas with a sharp, professional, and engaging tone. 4. **A link to your video editing portfolio/previous social media work.**

description: Affiliate & Editorial Commerce Systems Specialist — One-Time Setup Project ($400–$650) Job Type: Project-based / Gig (one-time build, **4 weeks maximum**) Budget: $400–$650 total, paid across 4 milestones (based on experience and scope handled) Skills: Affiliate Marketing · Google Sheets · WordPress Email applications to: ---------- Company: Chic Kitty / Shaggy Chic — a pet lifestyle media company About this project We're building a subtle, brand-governed editorial commerce system across a family of premium pet and lifestyle brands. **This is not a spammy affiliate role and not a generic VA role.** The public should feel "here is the world we curate" — never "here is an ad." Internally, we need a clean system for product approval, link tracking, affiliate outreach, content placement, and reporting. We need a highly organized operator to **build the system once and hand it off** with documentation **within 4 weeks**. There is potential to continue as a part-time maintenance coordinator afterward if the build is excellent — but this posting is for the one-time build. How approval works (important) Your job is to **research candidates, score them against our brand criteria, reject anything off-brand, and bring us a curated shortlist of the right products.** You do not publish or approve products on your own — **you propose, the owner gives final approval.** A product is never approved on commission alone; if it cheapens the brand, it doesn't belong. Brand fit always beats commission. What you'll build - A brand-specific product approval database** with scoring (brand fit, visual fit, audience value, quality/trust, content fit — each scored, with reject thresholds) - An affiliate program tracker** (program, network, application status, commission rate, cookie window, login notes) - A **link naming + UTM governance system** so no raw links float around - An outreach CRM** for affiliate applications, partner contacts, sample requests, and follow-ups - A blog monetization map** matching approved products to upcoming posts and "Approved" resource pages - A disclosure language library** (blog, email , Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, gifted products, paid partnerships) — FTC-compliant - A  weekly reporting dashboard** (clicks, sales, commissions, top products, top posts, top platforms) -SOPs so our team can add monetized links later without breaking the system 4-week milestone plan (approval gate between each) Milestone plan (4 weeks maximum — finishing sooner is welcome). Each milestone must be approved before the next begins; payment is released when each milestone is approved, not on a fixed schedule: Milestone 1 — Architecture: dashboard structure, brand approval matrix and scoring system, link naming + UTM rules, disclosure fields.  Owner approves the skeleton before research begins. Milestone 2 — Research + Curated Shortlist: research 100–150 candidates, score each, reject off-brand, organize by brand, and present a curated, scored shortlist to the owner for final approval. The owner picks what's approved. Milestone 3 — Applications, Outreach + Blog Map: apply to approved programs, build the outreach CRM and templates, map approved products to first posts, draft disclosure blocks. The total project fee is split across the four milestones and released as each is approved. What we need from you - Affiliate marketing research experience — you know how programs, commissions, and cookie windows work - Strong Google Sheets or Airtable organization - WordPress familiarity (placement planning, disclosure blocks) - Excellent English writing and careful attention to detail - The judgment to evaluate **brand fit, not just commission potential** - Comfortable working to a fixed 4-week, milestone-gated timeline - 100% original, human work — no AI-generated content. We screen for this. Logistics - One-time project, remote, **4 weeks maximum** - Reports to the Owner, with Operations Manager acceptance - Paid by milestone via PayPal or Remitly, released on approval of each milestone - Potential ongoing part-time maintenance role afterward if the build is excellent Screening task (include with your application) Choose **three products** you believe would fit a premium cat or dog lifestyle brand. Generic or AI-written responses won't move forward.

This is not a data-entry role. You'll own client books independently and review work done by others, so you need to genuinely understand why a payout never matches gross sales — fees, refunds, chargebacks, sales tax, held funds, and platform financing repayments that live in a separate report from the sales data. What you'll do: Own monthly close for multiple e-commerce clients in QuickBooks Online — categorization, reconciliation, and clean financials. Reconcile platform payouts to bank deposits, correctly separating gross sales, processing fees, refunds, and sales tax rather than booking the net deposit as revenue. Set up and maintain clearing accounts so sales, fees, and payouts flow correctly. Handle platform financing (e.g., Square Loans / Capital, Shopify Capital, PayPal Working Capital): book the funding as a liability, split repayments into principal vs. fee, and reconcile the liability against the platform's own loan/balance report each month. Account for cash sales, owner draws, and tender-type differences. Review junior bookkeepers' work and catch reconciliation errors before they reach the client. Required: 3+ years ecommerce bookkeeping, with strong QuickBooks Online expertise. Hands-on experience reconciling at least two of these: Square, Shopify, Stripe, Amazon, PayPal, Etsy. A real understanding of the payout-vs-sales gap and how to use a platform's reports to explain it. Strong written English and reliable overlap with US business hours (some hours between 9am–5pm Pacific Time). Accuracy, discretion with financial data, and the ability to work independently. Nice to have: Experience across several of the platforms above. Familiarity with platform financing products and how their repayments are reported. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification. **Screening — to apply, complete all of these:** Send the following to our WhatsApp at ---------- : 1. Start your application with the word PAYOUT so we know you read this post in full. 2. Answer this in 3–5 sentences: A client's Square sales report shows $10,000 in gross sales for the month, but only $8,900 was deposited to their bank, and they have an active Square Loan. Walk us through what makes up that $1,100 difference and which report you'd pull to confirm the loan portion. 3. Your resume (PDF) 4. A 1–2 minute video introduction telling us about your e-commerce bookkeeping experience and which platforms you've reconciled. Applications without the keyword, a real answer to the question, and a WhatsApp submission (resume + video) will not be reviewed.

This is not a basic dispute role—we need an expert who understands advanced consumer law tactics, aggressive dispute strategies, and how to force deletions across all bureaus and reporting agencies. Your primary goal is to deliver quick, aggressive turnaround times (30 to 45 days) for our clients while keeping meticulous track of their progress. If you know how to leverage the BBB, CFPB, FTC, and secondary bureaus to get results when basic Metro 2 disputes fail, we want you on our team. ## Key Responsibilities - **Advanced Disputing:** Draft and submit aggressive, customized disputes to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion. - **Secondary Bureau Sweeps:** Execute disputes and freezes with Innovis, LexisNexis, CoreLogic, SageStream, ARS, and other secondary reporting agencies. - **Regulatory Complaints:** File highly effective complaints with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB), Federal Trade Commission (FTC), and Better Business Bureau (BBB) to force investigations and deletions. - **Banking & Checking Removals:** Successfully dispute and remove negative records from ChexSystems and Early Warning Services (EWS). - **Client Tracking & CRM Management:** Meticulously track all client progress, dispute rounds, and correspondence in our CRM to ensure no client falls through the cracks. - **Aggressive Turnarounds:** Maintain a strict schedule to ensure rapid results, targeting significant deletions within a 30 to 45-day window. ## Requirements & Qualifications - **Proven Experience:** Minimum 2+ years of experience specifically in advanced credit repair and consumer law disputes (FCRA, FCBA, FDCPA). - **Expert Knowledge:** Deep understanding of how to bypass e-OSCAR and automated OCR systems using CFPB, BBB, and FTC complaints. - **Secondary Bureau Mastery:** You must know exactly how to handle Innovis, ChexSystems, and Early Warning Services removals. - **High Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple client files simultaneously without missing dispute deadlines. - **Aggressive Mindset:** You don't take "verified" for an answer. You know how to escalate and push back until the item is removed. - **Tech-Savvy:** Comfortable using credit repair software (e.g., Client Dispute Manager, Credit Repair Cloud) and CRM platforms. ## What We Offer - Competitive salary based on experience and performance. - Long-term job stability with a growing company. - Performance bonuses for fast and consistent deletions. - A supportive and fast-paced remote work environment. ## How to Apply If you are the aggressive, results-driven disputer we are looking for, please apply with: 1. A brief summary of your experience with CFPB, BBB, and FTC disputes. 2. Examples of your success with ChexSystems or Early Warning Services. 3. Your expected salary or hourly rate. 4. Put the word "AGGRESSIVE DISPUTER" in the subject line of your application so we know you read this entire post.

title: Content Creator — Social Media & Email
description: ABOUT THE ROLE I’m Attia Qureshi — a negotiation expert, keynote speaker, and the author of Never Settle (Simon & Schuster, 2026). AQ Consulting LLC is the company behind that work: the book, the Archetype Quiz, and a growing body of teaching for academic and executive audiences. I’m hiring an independent contractor to build and run the visual and production layer of my content presence — turning talks, essays, and half-formed ideas into a steady drumbeat of posts and email s that land with the right readers. You’ll design carousels, edit short-form video, draft newsletters from my source material, and manage the posting cadence across platforms. You’ll work directly with me. Real ownership of the creative execution, fast feedback, your fingerprints on everything that goes out. The voice and messaging are mine; the craft of making it look and feel right is yours. WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER EACH WEEK Instagram — 5 posts. Carousels, quote cards, Reels, stories. Repurposing long-form content (talks, writing, podcasts) into native short-form. Replies, DMs, comments — the community side, not just the broadcast side. LinkedIn — 2 native posts + 2 cross-posts. Native posts skew toward essays, carousels, and short video for executive and academic readers. Light, intelligent engagement in the comments of people doing interesting work. Email — 1 newsletter. Drafting from my source material, editing, scheduling, reporting on opens and clicks. You’ll work from my voice and notes, not from a blank page. A short weekly recap. What posted, what worked, what didn’t, what we’re testing next. Once the above is humming, we expand into YouTube Shorts and TikTok. You’ll help design that rollout. Lead time matters. Content should be drafted, reviewed, and scheduled well ahead of posting — not assembled the day it goes out. I’ll deliver a weekly source pack (talks, drafts, clips, themes) by Monday. You won’t be sourcing raw material on the clock, and I expect a buffer of approved content ready to go at all times. TOOLS YOU’LL USE Canva, CapCut, Buffer or Later, an email platform (Kit, Beehiiv, or similar). Comfort with at least two is expected. Curiosity to pick up the rest is non-negotiable. WHO YOU ARE — You create. Natively, regularly, on at least one of Instagram, LinkedIn, or TikTok. You don’t just manage social — you make things. — You design well. Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy. Your carousels look intentional, not templated. — You write in your own voice — and you can hold someone else’s without flattening it. You’ll draft captions and newsletter copy from my material, close enough that my edits are light, not rewrites. All writing must be your own. No AI-generated copy. — You edit video. You can cut a 60-second Reel or Short from a longer talk and make it land. — You track what’s working right now. You follow trends in format, pacing, hooks, and platform behavior — and you bring that awareness into what you create. Not chasing trends for their own sake, but knowing what’s current and adapting it to fit the brand. — You are obsessive about brand consistency. Fonts, colors, tone, spacing — every post should feel like it came from the same hand. I’ll provide brand guidelines; you’ll internalize them and hold yourself to them without being reminded. — You’re drawn to the ideas — negotiation, leadership, personal development, the challenge of translating academic work for a public audience. You don’t need to be an expert; you need to actually be curious. — You ship on a schedule without being chased. You build a buffer and stay ahead of deadlines, not on top of them. — You take feedback well, and a lot of it. Most of what you’ll hear early on is voice-calibration, not criticism. — You’d rather build a system once than redo the same work twice. Bonus: experience repurposing podcast or video content; you’ve worked inside an email platform before; background in marketing, communications, design, or writing. LOGISTICS — Effort: 6–8 hours/week. You set your own schedule against weekly delivery dates. — Pay: $5–10/hr USD based on experience and expertise, paid as an independent contractor. You’ll use your own equipment; AQ Consulting provides access to brand accounts and the weekly source pack. Growth bonus tied to audience milestones — we’ll define these together. — Duration: 10 weeks to start, with strong potential to continue indefinitely. — Cadence: one 30-minute weekly call scheduled in U.S. Eastern Time, plus async approvals within 24 hours. You must be available for this call on a consistent basis — this is not negotiable. — Location: fully remote, open to applicants worldwide. — Start: mid-June 2026. — Required before start: signed Independent Contractor Agreement, mutual NDA, and IP assignment of all work product to AQ Consulting LLC. HOW TO APPLY Email ---------- with the subject line: Content Creator — [Your Name] Include: 1. Resume or portfolio link. 2. Three work samples — one from each: — Something in your own voice. — Something you made in someone else’s voice or for a brand. — One piece of repurposing — long-form turned into short-form. Links preferred. If a piece can’t be shared publicly, describe it in 2–3 sentences. 3. A short note telling me: — Why this role? What about this kind of work pulled you in? — What will you bring that nobody else applying will? Specificity over polish. A point of view over a performance. I’d rather read one paragraph that could only have been written by you than a full page of careful prose anyone could have sent. Applications reviewed on a rolling basis. Finalists will be invited to a paid trial project ($40–60 USD) — drafting one newsletter and one Instagram carousel from source material I’ll provide — reviewed within five business days. AQ CONSULTING LLC ----------

description: You'll be the human our customers actually want to reach. Write like a warm, clear human — not a script or a robot ? Stay calm and kind when someone's upset, and don't take it personally ? Take real ownership: you'd rather solve it now than pass it along ? Have an instinct for empathy, especially with older or worried customers ? Are organized enough to keep dozens of conversations moving without dropping anyone ? You will work on landmark-scale projects alongside experienced engineers and coordinators, in a team culture built on respect and collaboration. For a skilled Revit modeler ready to work at the standard that tier-one Australian construction demands, this is the kind of role that builds a career. Compensation and Benefits: PHP 45,000–60,000 per month Fully remote setup Paid Time Off + Prepaid HMO coverage Performance bonus Weekends off, dayshift hours Ready to Apply? Schedule: Monday–Friday, minimum 3 hours daily overlap with US Pacific Time (Los Angeles) Start: Immediately for the right person About the Brand You'll be editing for the personal brand of a young entrepreneur based in Los Angeles. The content centers on luxury and exotic cars — cinematic rolling shots, POV drives, cold starts, exhaust clips, and lifestyle content — with a YouTube channel launching soon. The page is built on fast-paced, premium, scroll-stopping edits. This is not a generalist editing job. Engine and exhaust audio mixed properly with music, beat-synced cuts, SFX, clean transitions between natural sound and track Speed ramps, zoom transitions, velocity-style edits, smooth slow-mo Color grade automotive footage so paint, reflections, and night shots actually pop Edit primarily in the Edits app by Instagram (required workflow — non-negotiable) Deliver in both 9:16 (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) and 16:9 (YouTube) Stay on top of what's trending in the car content niche — formats, sounds, hooks — and bring ideas, not just deliverables Communicate daily on progress and turnaround Requirements (Must-Have) 3+ years of video editing experience — verifiable Must own an iPhone (iPhone 11 or newer) — the entire workflow runs through the Edits app by Instagram, and you must be fully comfortable editing in it Short-form specialist — Reels, TikToks, Shorts. You live in this format YouTube editing experience — you've edited full-length YouTube videos, not just shorts Strong sound design skills — you understand how to balance engine audio with music and cut to the beat Portfolio with proof: You must provide the exact ---------- of accounts you've created content for, tell us which specific videos you edited, and your exact role on each. We will verify. No real accounts with your real work = no application Fast, stable internet — you'll be downloading large 4K iPhone files daily - Upload a photo of your internet speed. Strong written English and reliable daily communication Willing to sign an NDA — footage, locations, and content plans stay private, and nothing gets reposted to your own pages without written approval Heavily Weighted (Tell Us If You Have This) Car/automotive content editing experience — if you've edited for car pages, dealerships, automotive creators, or detailing/wrap shops, lead with it. Show us your best automotive edits CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects as secondary tools Thumbnail design for YouTube Basic motion graphics Understanding of Instagram analytics and what drives retention and shares in the car niche How We Hire Apply with everything listed below Shortlisted applicants do a paid test edit — we send you raw car footage, you deliver a finished reel, we pay you for your time The best test edit gets the job, starting with a 2-week paid trial (trial period is hourly regardless of your chosen pay structure) How to Apply Start your application with the word "REDLINE" as the very first word. Applications that don't will be deleted unread — this is how we filter people who don't pay attention to detail. Then include: A Loom video (3–5 minutes) — screen-record your best edit (a car edit if you have one) and walk us through it: why that hook, why you cut where you cut, how you handled the audio, and what you'd improve. We want to hear how you think Links to your 5 best short-form edits you personally edited — car content first if you have it The exact ---------- of every account you've created content for, with your specific role on each Your YouTube editing samples — channel or video links Answers to these four questions: You're handed 5 minutes of raw footage from a supercar shoot — rolling shots, interior clips, a cold start, and a launch. Walk us through your exact process to turn it into a 12-second reel, and how long it takes you Which pay structure do you prefer — hourly or per-video — and why? If hourly, what is your desired hourly rate? Why This Role Matters This isn't backlog work. You'd be the founding editor for a personal brand with a real garage, real content output, and a YouTube channel about to launch. The person who takes this seat and delivers grows with it — into a Lead Editor role with consistent long-term work, weekly pay, and genuine creative input. Car content is the niche; if it's your niche, this is the kind of seat you want. If you've read this far and you're the right person, you already know it. Show us.

title: Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer
description: JOB OVERVIEW OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND Authority Solutions® is a digital marketing agency that focuses on Web Design, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), and AI-powered marketing technology to increase revenue for our clients. Founded in 2014, the company has grown year over year and has worked with remote tea ---------- mbers in the Philippines since the beginning. We serve clients in Medical, Legal, Ecommerce, and Home Services verticals — and we're building internal SaaS products to power our own growth and eventually serve the broader market. The company plans to 3X its revenue in the next 12 months, and this role is central to making that happen. We are not a typical agency. We build our own tools. We use AI (Claude Code, GPT, automation agents) daily. We ship fast, iterate constantly, and expect our team to own what they build. If you want to be part of a small, high-output team where your work directly drives growth — keep reading. ****Note to applicants***** This post has been refreshed and updated June 18, 2026. Please apply and expect a response back within 24-48 hours. We are looking to onboard this position by the end of June ************* JOB TITLE Full-Stack Developer & Automation Engineer JOB OVERVIEW We're hiring a developer who can operate across two equally important domains: 1) Internal SaaS Product Development (50%) — Design, build, and ship lightweight internal web applications from the ground up using React/Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel. These are greenfield builds. You'll own the full stack — database design, API layer, frontend UI, auth, deployment, and iteration based on team feedback. 2) Automation & Integration Engineering (50%) — Architect, build, and maintain business-critical automation workflows (primarily n8n) that connect our CRM (GoHighLevel), ecommerce (WooCommerce), project management (ClickUp), communication (Slack), and operational systems (Google Sheets). You own the plumbing between platforms — making sure data, orders, pipelines, and alerts flow correctly with bulletproof error handling. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will not be waiting for tickets. You will be working directly with company leadership to understand what needs to be built, then building it. WHO YOU ARE You're a builder. You get energy from shipping things, not fro ---------- etings about shipping things. You're comfortable with ambiguity. "Here's the problem, figure out the best solution" is exciting to you, not stressful. You use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) daily and consider them a multiplier, not a crutch. This is a hard requirement. You can context-switch between writing a React component in the morning and debugging a webhook integration in the afternoon. You document what you build so others can understand and maintain it. You communicate proactively — especially when something is blocked, broken, or behind schedule. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS Full-Stack Development React / Next.js — Building production web applications from scratch (not just modifying templates) Supabase — Database design, Row Level Security, Edge Functions, Auth, Realtime subscriptions Vercel — Deployment, environment management, serverless functions JavaScript/TypeScript — Strong fundamentals, not just copy-paste from Stack Overflow Tailwind CSS — Clean, responsive UI implementation REST APIs — Designing and consuming APIs, authentication patterns, error handling Git — Version control discipline (branching, PRs, meaningful commits) Automation & Integration Engineering n8n (or equivalent workflow automation platform) — Multi-step workflows including webhooks, cron schedules, branching logic, data transformations, retries, idempotency, and error handling GoHighLevel (GHL) — Pipelines, CRM entities, webhooks, API integrations WooCommerce — Orders, inventory, payment events, cancellation logic, REST API ClickUp — Task management integrations, status updates, messaging Slack — Notification workflows, integration patterns Google Sheets — As an operational input/output layer for bulk actions and data mapping AI-Assisted Development (Hard Requirement) Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot — Daily proficiency. You use AI tools to ship faster and higher quality, not as a replacement for understanding what you're building. Ability to evaluate, prototype, and recommend AI-powered features and tooling improvements for internal use. PREFERRED / NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS Experience building chatbots or conversational AI agents (GHL, Convocore, Voiceflow, or similar) WordPress custom API integrations and plugin development Experience with Stripe or payment processing integrations Familiarity with SEO tools and marketing technology platforms Experience modeling API costs at scale Infrastructure management on Render, Railway, or similar platforms CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Internal SaaS Development Build greenfield internal web applications (React/Next.js + Supabase + Vercel) from concept to production Own the full product lifecycle: database schema design, API development, frontend UI, authentication, deployment, and ongoing iteration Current product roadmap includes internal tools for content production, SEO auditing, and local SEO workflows — you will build these from scratch Write clean, maintainable code with documentation Ship iteratively — working prototypes first, then polish based on team feedback Automation Workflow Engineering Design and deploy multi-step n8n automation workflows that synchronize data across GHL, WooCommerce, ClickUp, Slack, and Google Sheets Build and maintain workflows including: sale event syncing (GHL ? WooCommerce), bulk restock pipelines, daily operational summaries, low-stock alerts, and reconciliation jobs Implement robust error handling: retries, deduplication, dead-letter patterns, audit logging, and alerting Establish reusable workflow patterns with consistent naming conventions, standardized nodes, and environment variable management Data Integrity & Reliability Build reconciliation workflows with auto-fix strategies where feasible Ensure deduplication persistence to prevent duplicate downstream actions Validate workflow correctness across edge cases (failed payments, cancellation restores, multi-item orders, out-of-order webhooks) Maintain audit logs so changes can be traced and diagnosed Testing & Deployment Define and execute structured test plans for both SaaS features and automation workflows Manage deployment across environments (dev, staging, production) Drive releases from development to production with verification, observability, and rollback plans Documentation & Operational Visibility Document all workflows, system architectures, and runbooks Build operational dashboards and status outputs for team visibility Maintain mapping systems (SKU mapping, integration object mapping, API documentation) AI Tooling & Continuous Improvement Conduct internal audits of AI usage and tooling opportunities Prototype new automation capabilities including AI-powered agents and chat-driven workflows Evaluate and recommend tools and processes that improve team productivity BASIC & SOFT SKILLS Self-Directed Problem Solver — You research, troubleshoot, and find answers independently before escalating. Google, documentation, and AI tools are your first line of defense. Time Management — You show up on time for meetings, hit deadlines, and communicate early if timelines shift. Independent Worker / Self-Starter — You do not need daily supervision to stay productive and on task. Strong Written Communication — You can explain technical decisions, write clear documentation, and communicate status updates without being asked. Ownership Mentality — If you built it, you own it. Bugs, performance, uptime — it's yours until it's handed off. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 30 Days: Onboarded to all systems (n8n, GHL, WooCommerce, ClickUp, Supabase, Vercel) Shipped at least one small internal tool or meaningful feature Taken over and stabilized existing automation workflows Established working relationship and communication rhythm with leadership First 90 Days: First internal SaaS product in production and being used by the team All critical automation workflows documented, monitored, and running reliably Proactively identifying and proposing improvements to systems and processes Operating independently with minimal direction on day-to-day priorities First 6 Months: Multiple internal SaaS tools shipped and iterating based on usage Automation infrastructure is reliable, observable, and well-documented You've become the team's go-to for "how should we build this?" questions Measurable time savings and operational improvements from your work WORK SCHEDULE & HOLIDAYS All staff work a split shift so we can communicate on pertinent tasks or have tea ---------- etings as needed with US leadership. As a company we observe all US holidays, as well as PH public holidays (New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Bataan Day, Labour Day, Philippines Independence Day, National Heroes' Day, Bonifacio Day, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Christmas Day, Rizal Day). We work hard and value time with our families. After 90 day probationary period all staff qualify for leave with proper notice based on employee handbook regulations. SALARY RANGE Full Time $10–$12/hr USD (based upon knowledge, technical abilities, and demonstrated experience) Performance-based increases as responsibilities grow PERKS & BENEFITS Access to paid development tools and platforms (Supabase, Vercel, n8n, API subscriptions) Access to AI development tools (Claude Pro, Cursor, etc.) Access to paid training and courses for professional development Direct access to company leadership — your ideas get heard and implemented fast Opportunity to architect and build products from the ground up, not just maintain someone else's code Small team environment where your contributions are visible and valued Clear path to increased responsibility and compensation as the company scales HOW TO APPLY Do not send a generic application. We will ignore it. Instead, include the following in your application: A brief introduction — Who you are, what you've built recently, and why this role interests you. A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or examples of shipped work — We want to see things you've actually built and deployed, not tutorial projects. Your experience with AI-assisted development — Which tools you use, how they fit into your workflow, and a specific example of how they helped you ship faster or better. One question you have about the role — This tells us you actually read the posting. Applications that follow these instructions will be reviewed first.

job_title: Senior Bookkeeper (Full-Time) | US Firm, QBO ProAdvisor Required
description: Are you an experienced bookkeeper who has worked for a US firm and is looking for a stable, long-term, full-time home instead of another short-term gig? I'm Chris Kocina, owner of LivFree Bookkeeping, a US-based firm serving 30+ small-business clients. We're a small, tight team that values doing the work right over doing it fast. My values are stewardship, integrity, and service, and I run the business that way. I'm hiring one experienced Senior Bookkeeper to own production for a set of clients and to grow with us long-term. This is a real seat on a small team, not a faceless data-entry pool. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients: bank and credit card reconciliations, GL maintenance, and month-end close - Routine client email communication: responding to updates, requesting documents, following up, and logging tasks in our client portal - Hitting our firm-wide close deadlines on a defined close calendar - Quality review support on a junior bookkeeper's work, under my direction - Documenting processes as we build them (we record short Loom walkthroughs) - Flagging complex or unusual client situations to me early You won't be thrown in alone. You'll ramp into client communication over the first few weeks and work alongside our lead bookkeeper. WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT OWN - Sales or new client acquisition - Pricing decisions - Hiring or firing decisions - High-level client relationship management (I keep this) This is a senior production role with room to grow into more responsibility over time as you prove fit. I'm being honest that it is not a guaranteed manager title on day one. MUST-HAVES (non-negotiable) - 5+ years of bookkeeping experience - QBO ProAdvisor certified (QuickBooks Online is the core of everything we do) - You have worked for a US bookkeeping firm before, not just BPO data entry - You have independently closed books for multiple clients - Professional, clear written English (you will be email ing clients directly) - True full-time availability. This must be your primary job, not a side gig. NICE-TO-HAVES (a plus, not required) - Experience with Double (formerly Keeper), Gusto, or Ramp - Construction or job-costing experience - Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) in your daily workflow HOW WE WORK We are an AI-first firm. Every tea ---------- mber uses AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT as a normal part of their work to ensure efficiency and accuracy. If that excites you, you'll fit right in. We have clear rules about never putting client data into public AI tools without authorization, and we train you on this. NOT A FIT IF - You want a side gig or are juggling another full-time employer - You prefer pure task execution and don't want to own outcomes - Your written English is not yet client-ready - You go quiet when things get busy instead of communicating THE SETUP - Long-term, full-time role (40 hrs/week), not a short contract - Remote, Philippines-based, flexible schedule with some daily overlap to US Central Time - We start with a paid 2-week trial. During the trial, you connect securely from your own computer into our company system, so no client data is ever stored on your personal machine. Once you pass the trial, we ship you a fully configured company laptop with all your tools installed. - 1099 independent contractor arrangement - Structured onboarding and training in your first weeks, with 30-day and 90-day check-ins COMPENSATION $11 to $13 per hour USD to start, depending on experience. I review compensation at your 90-day mark and as your responsibilities grow. Strong performance is rewarded here. The better you do and the more you own, the more you earn. I want this to be a long-term home, and I pay people accordingly. HOW TO APPLY Email me directly at ---------- this exact subject line, filling in the bracket: LivFree Senior Bookkeeper Application, [name the part of this role that excites you most] In your email , include: 1. One sentence on what stood out to you in this posting, so I know you read it 2. A short intro on your bookkeeping background, including which US firm(s) you've worked for 3. Brief answers, in your own words, to these four questions: - How would you handle a client frustrated about a missed deadline? - A client hasn't reconciled their bank feed in 4 months and keeps dodging your requests for statements. How do you handle it? - You're reviewing a junior bookkeeper's work and notice recurring errors in their bank reconciliations. How do you address it with them? - Tell me about a complex client situation you handled well. 4. Your hourly rate expectation 5. Confirmation that this would be your primary full-time job I read every serious application and respond to strong ones quickly. Applications that ignore these instructions or skip the questions won't be considered.

title: STR Operations & Admin Specialist
description: A NOTE FROM MICHAEL Hi there — my name is Michael Saade, founder of Stay With The Saades. We are a short-term rental co-hosting company that specializes in creating unforgettable experiences for families traveling with their kids and pets, while helping property investors maximize the revenue potential of their portfolios. We are growing, and I need a right hand. Someone I can trust to own their responsibilities, build systems where there aren't any, and show up ready to solve problems before I even know they exist. This is not a task-and-checklist role — it's a real partnership with real ownership. If that excites you, keep reading. OUR CORE VALUES Build a Plan Planned work leads to more freedom and better outcomes. We think ahead — through the day, the week, the month — so we can pivot when things need our attention. We also believe everyone deserves time to recharge, and that should always be part of the plan. Cut Your Path We are risk takers who aren't afraid to figure things out. We value curiosity and initiative, and there is no shame in making a mistake — only in not learning from one. Put in the Work We show up as our best selves. We are genuinely curious about how to be better at what we do and who we are, and we are committed to the kind of growth that makes a real difference. People Matter Most Everything we do is centered on human interaction. We treat everyone — guests, owners, vendors, teammates — with respect and kindness. We do what is right for the people we work with and for. Make It Fun We take pride in what we do, but we don’t take ourselves so seriously that we can’t laugh at ourselves and our circumstances. The best problem solving usually starts with a chuckle. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Guest Operations & Issue Resolution – Track guest-related charges and issues — damages, late checkouts, cleaning disputes, etc. – Collect documentation (invoices, photos, vendor reports) and file Airbnb Resolution Center or insurance claims – Maintain a running log of all reported i ---------- and their resolution status – Coordinate early check-ins and late check-outs with follow-up on listing-related tasks – Keep systems, files, and documentation organized and up to date Bookkeeping & Financial Admin – Support day-to-day bookkeeping – Build and maintain an expense tracking system – Categorize receipts and verify invoice accuracy before anything goes out – Create checks and balances for expense reporting – Compile and file monthly tax details and reports Systems & SOPs – Build operational processes and SOPs from scratch as we scale – Document workflows and create systems for consistency and accountability – When submitting your application, include the title of your favorite book or system that has had the biggest impact on how you manage your schedule and stay organized – Maintain and improve those systems over time WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR – Highly hospitality, or property management is a plus REQUIREMENTS – Reliable high-speed internet connection — you will be required to submit a speedtest.net result with your application – Your own computer with a backup power and internet solution in case of outages – A quiet, dedicated work environment – This must be your only employment — we require your full dedication during working hours – Availability Thursday through Monday, 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM PST (1 hour unpaid lunch) THE DETAILS – Full-time, fully remote position – Competitive hourly rate based on experience – The initial employment term will be a 30-day trial period – Stable, long-term role with a growing company – Direct access to leadership and real ownership of your work HOW TO APPLY If you’re interested in this position, please submit the following: – A short intro about yourself and your relevant experience – Your resume or work history – A 2–3 minute video recording (phone or computer, any format) introducing yourself, explaining why you’re the right fit, and sharing your top three strengths as an assistant – Your speedtest.net result for internet speed verification – Examples of SOPs, trackers, or systems you’ve built — if you have them – Your availability and current hourly rate
