description: Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller! Location: Remote / Work From Home Reports to: CEO About the Company Ikigai Cases ( ---------- ) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail. About the Role We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO. The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need. At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports. Core Responsibilities Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required. Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models. Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation. Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO. Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively. Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits. CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec. Why You Should Take This Role -You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: ---------- -A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. -You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain. -The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers. -You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person. Required Experience & Skills -5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations -Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it -E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax -Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision -Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically -US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles) -Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets -Payroll experience across multiple platforms -Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables) -Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform -Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders Nice-to-Have Experience -Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines -Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states -Experience using Notion (or similar task management software) -EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity -Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors What We’re Really Looking For -Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed: -Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur. -Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable. -Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required. -Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right. -Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately. Compensation Details & Schedule -Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening. -Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST). -Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year -PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company -Location: Remote / Work From Home To Apply Fill out the application form here: ---------- This application includes a number of questions in order to ensure we hire an outstanding candidate for this position, so please be advised in advance that it will take time to complete. title: D2C Sales Closer (Remote, High-Ticket Education)
description: **Read This First** I've built a direct-to-consumer career-training business in the U.S. with one of the largest organic audiences in the space — 60 million+ organic views generating thousands of inbound inquiries every month, with no de minimus paid media budget. The funnel is built. The pipeline is full. The scripts, the follow-up sequences, and the CRM are all already in place. The offer is proven. Now I'm looking for a hard working, motivated professional to run it with me. This is a full time D2C sales role. You won't be one of fifty reps fighting for scraps — you'll own the entire D2C sales process I've built, with warm leads coming to you every day. This is not for “passengers”. I need a driver. You're not starting from zero and you're not cold-calling. The hard part — generating demand — is already done. Thousands of qualified people reach out to us every month. Your job is to connect with the ones we can genuinely help and guide them to a decision. If you want a quiet job to coast in, this is NOT it. If you're hungry, hardworking, and want to earn based on what you actually produce, keep reading. **About the Opportunity** We help hardworking U.S. adults launch new careers without years of school or heavy debt. You'll sell one program: Pharmacy Technician — a recognized credential, with a hands-on externship built into the program that connects students to real employer experience at pharmacies and hospitals. **Who You're Selling To** This is not an impulse purchase, and you can't sell it like one. Our customers are hardworking adults who already know they need new skills to get ahead. They want this. What stops them is fear — fear of spending money they've carefully budgeted on something that might not pay off. That fear is reasonable, and we respect it. Your job is to help the right people see clearly — to identify the ones who are a genuine fit and help them understand the return: what the credential is worth, what the externship gives them, and why the price is small compared to the career it opens up. it’s a Challenger sales model. **What You'll Do** - Run consultative sales calls — by phone or Zoom — with warm leads who already applied and booked themselves - Follow up with discipline. Most people don't enroll on the first call; career-education decisions usually take two to four conversations, so consistent follow-up is where the results come from - Own the pipeline. The scripts, sequences, and CRM are already built — but they're yours to run: texts, email s, notes, and follow-ups until you close or disqualify - Learn the program inside and out — the credential, the externship, the path to a job — so prospects trust you - Get coached by experienced sales leadership and improve the process as you run it **What I'm Looking For** - Experience selling higher education, online courses, or coaching programs — this is a longer, more consultative sale, and you need to understand that cycle - A real closing track record - Excellent spoken and written English — your calls and follow-ups must be clear and professional - A reliable home setup: fast internet, a quiet space, a good headset and webcam - Able to work U.S. time zones - Coachable, fast to apply feedback, no ego - Hungry, hardworking, resilient — you treat this like it's yours, because it will be **The Money** This is a commission-heavy role with uncapped earning. You're paid a flat commission for every enrollment you close and collect — the more you close, the more you earn, with no limit. Consistent closers earn excellent monthly income by local standards, and top performers earn well beyond that. We'll go through exact numbers on the call. **What to Expect** This is not an easy job, and warm leads don't change that. The people you talk to are interested, but most need follow-up and reassurance before they commit. If you need a lot of handholding or you fold under pressure, this won't be a fit. But if you're hungry, coachable, and you know how to sell, this is a rare chance to run a proven business as your own — and earn based entirely on what you produce. job_title: Senior Graphics & Packaging Designer — Own the Visual Identity of Two Brands
description: **Company:** Intent Brands (two brands: Aerotrunk + SurviveX) **Location:** Remote (Philippines preferred) **Type:** Full-time (40 hrs/week) **Compensation:** $2,000 USD/month + 13th month pay **Start:** Immediately --- ## About Us Intent Brands runs two consumer product brands sold on Amazon and our own Shopify store: - **SurviveX** — Premium first aid and emergency preparedness kits. Medical/tactical aesthetic. Clean, confident, authoritative design language. Colors: Red (#E30829), Black (#1A1A1A), Dark Gray (#3D3D3D), White. - **Aerotrunk** — Premium hardside luggage. Modern, aspirational travel lifestyle aesthetic. We're a small, fast-moving team. You won't be "the designer who gets handed mockups to resize." You'll own the entire visual output for both brands — from packaging dielines to Amazon A+ content to social media assets. Your work will be on shelves, in search results, and in customers' hands. --- ## What You'll Actually Do (Weekly) - **Packaging design** — Retail-ready packaging, inserts, labels, and stickers. You'll work directly with dieline templates from our manufacturers and deliver print-ready files (CMYK, bleeds, crop marks, PDF/X-1a or AI). - **Amazon listing images** — Main images, infographics, lifestyle composites, comparison charts, and A+ Content modules. You understand Amazon's image requirements and what converts. - **Brand store pages** — Design and maintain Amazon Brand Store layouts for both brands. - **Shopify assets** — Homepage banners, collection images, email campaign graphics. - **Social media** — Instagram, TikTok, Facebook creative. Static and motion graphics. - **Product photography direction** — You may not shoot photos, but you'll composite, retouch, and art-direct product imagery using renders, stock, and AI-generated elements. - **Brand consistency** — Maintain and evolve brand guidelines for two very different brands simultaneously. --- ## What We're Looking For This is a **senior role**. We're not looking for someone who can use Photoshop — we're looking for someone whose portfolio makes us say "we need to hire this person before someone else does." ### Must-Have Skills - **Packaging design** — You've designed retail packaging that went to print. You know dielines, bleeds, safe zones, overprint, spot colors, and substrate considerations. You've dealt with manufacturer feedback and revised files for production. - **Amazon content** — You've created listing images and A+ content that you can show us. You understand what converts on Amazon (not just what looks pretty). - **Print production** — CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X, press-ready files. You know the difference between RGB mockups and production-ready artwork. - **Adobe Creative Suite mastery** — Illustrator (packaging, vector), Photoshop (compositing, retouching), InDesign (inserts, guides). These are your daily tools, not occasional ones. - **Typography & layout** — You have strong opinions about type hierarchy, spacing, and readability at small scales (packaging, labels, inserts). ### Strong Plus - **Motion graphics** — After Effects or similar for social content, product animations - **3D mockups** — Blender, Dimension, or similar for product visualization - **AI image tools** — Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or similar for concepting and asset generation - **Figma** — For collaborative design, UI work, or rapid prototyping - **Medical/health product design** — Experience with FDA-regulated labels (Drug Facts panels, mandatory copy) - **Bilingual English** — Your English needs to be strong enough to read briefs, present concepts, and explain design decisions in writing --- ## Screening Questions (Answer All 4) > **Include the phrase "I design for production" somewhere in your application.** This tells us you read the full listing. ### Q1: Packaging Portfolio Piece Show us one packaging project you're most proud of — something that went to physical production. Tell us: - What was the product? - What were the print specs and constraints? - What was your process from concept to final production file? - Show the final printed result (photo of the physical product) alongside your design file if possible. ### Q2: Amazon Listing Challenge Pick one of these two scenarios and walk us through how you'd approach it: **Option A:** Our first aid kit's main image has a 3% click-through rate (below category average of 4.5%). The current image is a straight product shot on white. What would you change and why? What would you A/B test first? **Option B:** We need to create 7 listing images for a new luggage product. Walk us through what each image slot would contain and why, based on what you know converts on Amazon. ### Q3: Two Brands, One Designer SurviveX is medical/tactical (red, black, authoritative). Aerotrunk is travel/lifestyle (modern, aspirational, premium). How do you switch between two very different brand identities without the work starting to look the same? Give us a specific technique or process you use. ### Q4: Tools & Speed What's your full design stack? For each major tool, tell us honestly: daily driver, weekly, or occasional? Also: what's your typical turnaround for a set of 7 Amazon listing images from brief to final delivery? --- ## Paid Test Task Instead of multiple interview rounds, we'll ask our shortlisted candidates to complete a **paid design test** ($75 USD). title: Outbound Sales Caller: eCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery
job_title: Outbound Sales Caller: eCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Before you apply, please read this whole post. I'm looking for one specific type of person, and the application instructions at the bottom are designed to filter out everyone who isn't. If you follow them, you'll stand out immediately. I run a fast growing ecommerce store. Every day, dozens of customers add products to their cart and then leave without buying. Your job is to call those people, win them back, and close the sale over the phone. You get a monthly base plus a cash bonus for every cart you recover. The better you are, the more you earn, with no cap. This is phone work. If you love being on the phone and you're motivated by hitting targets, keep reading. If you'd rather do quiet admin or data entry, this is not the role for you. What you'll actually be doing: 1.Calling customers who abandoned their cart, usually within minutes to hours of them leaving the site 2. Reopening the conversation, handling objections (price, hesitation, "just looking", "I'll do it later"), and getting them to complete the purchase 3. Following up by call, SMS or email where needed 4. Logging every call outcome accurately so we can track what's working 5. Hitting daily call volume and weekly recovery targets What success looks like: You'll be measured on three things- 1. Dials and contacts per day (your activity) 2. Contact-to-recovery conversion rate (your skill) 3. Total carts recovered per week (the outcome that earns your bonus) I'll give you clear targets in week one and review your numbers with you weekly. Strong performers get more hours, more responsibility, and a bigger bonus structure over time. Must-haves (please don't apply without these): 1. Proven outbound phone experience: telesales, appointment setting, cold calling, collections, or BPO outbound campaigns. Tell me exactly what you did. 2. Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, confident phone voice 3. Genuine comfort and enjoyment on the phone, plus thick skin for rejection 4. Availability during Australian hours, roughly 10am to 8pm AEST (about 8am to 6pm Philippine time), since our customers are in Australia 5. Reliable high speed internet, a good quality headset, and a quiet place to call from 6. Reliability and honest reporting. I track outcomes, so there is nowhere to hide a slow day, and I reward consistency. Nice-to-haves (not necessary but will help you stand out): 1. Experience with WooCommerce, which is the platform we use day to day 2. Experience in DTC ecommerce or with consumer products 3. Experience selling to Australian or other Western customers 4. Familiarity with diallers, SMS tools, or CRMs in general 5. Experience working to a commission or bonus structure before About the product (so you can self-select): We sell nicotine products to adult customers in Australia. You must be comfortable calling on behalf of an adult nicotine product. If that's a problem for you, this isn't the right fit, and that's completely fine. Pay: 1. Starting rate: USD $6 per hour, paid for every hour you work from day one. This is your guaranteed base and it does not go away. 2. The first two weeks are a paid probation on this flat hourly rate while we assess how you perform. 3. After you pass probation, you keep the hourly base and move onto a performance bonus for every cart you recover. This is where the real money is. The earning potential is high and completely uncapped: the more carts you recover, the more you make, on top of your hourly rate. 4. To be clear, this is a real job with a guaranteed wage, not commission-only work. But if you're a strong closer, the bonus will quickly become the biggest part of your pay. 5. We pay on time, every time. Hours: We expect a minimum commitment of 38 hours per week during the Australian calling window above. However, since this is a bonus-driven job, you may choose to work more hours to increase your earnings. How to apply: I will only read applications that do all three of these - 1. Start your message with the word RINGER. This tells me you read the entire post. Applications without it get deleted unread. 2. Attach a voice recording, maximum 60 seconds. Pretend you're calling a customer who left a few tins of nicotine pouches in their cart and didn't check out. Win them back. I want to hear your real phone voice, your tone, and how you'd open the call. Don't overthink it, just record it. Feel free to make up any commercial points such as fast shipping, best prices etc. If you are unaware of nicotine pouches, please look up ZYN and VELO prior to making your recording. These are the 2 key brands that we retail. 3. Answer these three questions briefly: 1. How many months or years of outbound phone experience do you have, and what kind of campaigns (AU/US sales, appointment setting, collections, and so on)? 2. What dialler or CRM tools have you used? 3. What were you measured on in your last phone role, and what numbers did you actually hit? That's it. If you're a genuine phone closer who reads instructions and follows them, you'll be miles ahead of most applicants. I'm ready to hire quickly for the right person.

Read the incoming customer message 2. Paste it into our AI chatbot with the relevant context and instrucitons 3. The chatbot generates the reply 4. You review it — does it make sense? You don't need to be a native English writer — you need to understand English well enough to read a customer's message, know what they actually want, and recognize whether the AI's reply is correct or off. WHAT YOU HANDLE DAY-TO-DAY Most of the work is common, recurring customer questions: - "Where is my package?" — shipping status and tracking - "I want to return my order" — return and refund requests - "I haven't received my order yet" — missing parcel cases - "Is my order a pre-order?" — order status clarification - "My item arrived damaged" — product issue reports These make up 90% of the inbox. No phone calls, ever. - Cold outreach or sales. - Social media management or content creation. - A job where you need to write anything from scratch. It is structured inbox management with a clear system behind it. You paste, you review, you send. But you need the understanding to do it right. ???????????????????????????????

Strategic Vision: Ability to position each piece of copy within the broader context of the campaign strategy, marketing funnel, customer journey, sales process, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation. - description: Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist We're an established meta ads marketing agency looking for a high-volume Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist who can create direct-response static ad creatives for paid social campaigns. This is not a slow branding role. This is a fast-paced, production-based creative role for someone who can move quickly, follow briefs, use AI tools, and produce a high volume of clean, usable ad creatives every day. We work with fast-growing brands and move quickly as a team. We care deeply about client results, clear communication, strong execution, and high standards. You will be responsible for producing 100 static ad creatives per day, Monday through Friday, using assigned briefs, templates, hooks, offers, client assets, and creative direction. We use Asana for project management and Slack for daily team communication. What You’ll Do In this role, you will create high-volume static ad creatives for Facebook and Instagram campaigns. Your work will be used for direct-response testing, so the goal is not just to make things look good. The goal is to create clean, readable, launch-ready ads that clearly communicate the hook, offer, and message. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who is fast, organized, creative, coachable, and comfortable with high-volume production. You do not need to be the world’s fanciest designer. You do need to be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to create ads that are clear enough to test. You should understand that paid social creative needs to sell, not just look pretty. You should have experience with: Area What We Expect Design tools Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools. AI creative tools ChatGPT, Midjourney, Higgsfield, OpenAI image tools, or similar. Paid social creative Experience creating Facebook and Instagram static ad creatives. Direct-response design Ability to create ads with clear hooks, strong hierarchy, readable text, and obvious offers. Workflow tools Comfortable working inside Asana and Slack. High-volume production Ability to produce many variations quickly without becoming disorganized. Strong English communication is important because this role requires clear written updates, feedback loops, and daily coordination with the team. Key Metrics This role is measured by simple production and quality numbers. We care about speed, but we also care about accuracy, organization, and whether the creative is actually usable. Daily production volume 100 statics per day You are expected to produce 100 completed static ad creatives per workday, Monday through Friday. Weekly output 500 statics per week Your weekly production goal is 500 completed static ad creatives. QA pass rate 90%+ At least 90% of submitted creatives should pass our internal QA scorecard. QA includes things like correct offer, correct client or brand, correct dimensions, clear visual hierarchy, no spelling errors, proper file naming, organized folders, and whether the creative follows the assigned brief. What We Care About Most We want someone who takes ownership. If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you communicate. If a brief is missing something important, you flag it instead of guessing silently. If feedback is given, you apply it quickly and improve the next batch. We move fast, expect high standards, and care deeply about client results. The right person for this role is calm under pressure, organized in their workflow, and able to keep producing without letting quality fall apart. This role is a good fit for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable being measured by output. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of the creative production system, not someone who needs constant reminders or hand-holding. This Role Is a Good Fit If You •Like fast-paced creative production. •Are comfortable using AI tools. •Can follow directions without needing constant reminders. •Understand that ads need to sell, not just look pretty. •Can create lots of variations quickly. •Stay organized across clients, folders, files, and deadlines. •Communicate clearly in Slack. •Take feedback well and apply it quickly. •Can consistently hit daily output goals. •Stay calm under pressure. •Take ownership when something is unclear, missing, or needs to be fixed. This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You •Prefer slow branding projects. •Need several hours to make one design. •Dislike AI tools. •Struggle with organization. •Do not like being measured by output. •Disappear during work hours. •Get defensive about feedback. •Cannot consistently follow briefs. •Need constant reminders to complete assigned work. •Are uncomfortable with fast-paced agency-style work. Work Schedule This is a full-time role. Schedule Monday through Friday Hours 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, New York City time Location Open to worldwide applicants Communication Strong written English required Candidates must be available during the full working schedule and able to communicate clearly with the team throughout the day. We are looking for someone who can move fast, stay organized, communicate clearly, and consistently produce launch-ready creative at volume.

This individual will play a crucial role in post-production video editing, creating engaging and effective video assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing. Qualifications: At least 2 years of experience in video editing within the ecommerce marketing space, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work. Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and Davinci. Solid understanding of key metrics like hook rate, hold rate, and click through rate, and expertise in creating short-form direct response videos. A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous. Agency experience is a plus Experience using AI tools like Higgsfield, Claude, ChatGPT, and others BONUS: If you can create your own videos based on the brand data (winners, angles, content that’s working) - we pay out bonuses for this type of work Fluency in English is required. Key Competencies: Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts. Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality video assets. A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in video editing and content creation. Ability to utilize AI tools in the editing process as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative. Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling video content. A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new video concepts for our advertising campaigns. You need to be a self-starter. You will be given the creative freedom to create winning assets and data from the brands you work on. Overview: As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in video editing will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones. Roles and Responsibilities: Video Editing: You will be responsible for editing raw footage into polished content for Meta & TikTok. This involves cutting hooks effectively, creating a cohesive story through the video content, and making the video engaging and effective to drive higher thumb stop rates (staying past the first 3 seconds), longer hold times (watching for at least 15 seconds), and high click through rates. Collaboration: Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and other editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack. Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, storytelling elements, and visual style is highly valued. Project Management: Manage your video editing projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress. Quality Control: Ensure all videos meet ACTIV’s quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok. Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of video editing software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better. Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team. Working Hours: This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone. Expectations: Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report. Deliver high-quality video content within specified deadlines. Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines. Tools and Software: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, and other relevant video editing software is expected. Compensation: The Video Editor role is a dynamic position with the opportunity to significantly impact the success of our e-commerce clients through compelling video content. Recognizing the importance of this role, we offer competitive compensation packages for a full time role: Compensation: Compensation is dependent on location of hire and competitive pay for the region the video editor is in. You will be asked your expected range of pay in your job application. Note: Though output will be measured and managed, quality is essential. This is why we created a bonus structure that supports higher quality content that can scale spend behind it, versus creating a lot of content that may not scale spend behind it. Expectations and Growth: This role will be a full time role with expectations that we will provide you with the resources to succeed. title: Full-Stack Software Engineer — Automation & DevOps
description: --- About Authority Solutions® --- Authority Solutions® is a digital marketing agency specializing in Web Design, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), and AI-powered marketing technology that grows revenue for our clients. Founded in 2014, we've grown year over year and have worked with remote tea ---------- mbers in the Philippines since day one — they are core to who we are, not a side experiment. We serve clients in the Medical, Legal, Ecommerce, and Home Services verticals, and we build our own technology to power how we deliver. We are a cutting-edge agency at the front edge of SEO and AI implementation, and we plan to grow aggressively over the next 12 months. This role is central to making that happen. We are not a typical agency. We build our own tools. We use AI assistants and automation agents every day. We ship fast, iterate constantly, and expect every person on the team to own what they build. If you want a long-term home on a small, high-output team where your work directly drives the company forward — keep reading. Why this role is different Most agencies will hand you a ticket queue and a template to edit. We're handing you the keys. You'll architect and build real software from a blank page, stand up the infrastructure it runs on, and wire together the systems that keep the business moving. You'll work directly with company leadership — not three layers of management — to understand the problem, then go solve it. And here's the part that matters most for your career: you'll be building with the best AI development tooling available. Many talented engineers never get hands-on access to top-tier AI coding assistants and automation platforms. We use them daily, we pay for the good ones, and we'll put them in your hands on day one. If you're hungry to level up fast, this is where you do it — you'll leave this role a dramatically stronger engineer than you arrived. This is not a side gig. We're hiring one person for the long haul — someone who wants to grow with us, take on more responsibility and compensation over time, and treat what they build as their own. If you're collecting short contracts on the side, this isn't the right fit, and that's okay. If you're looking for a place to plant roots and build a career, read on. What you'll actually do This is a hands-on, high-ownership role across three connected areas: 1. Build full-stack web applications from scratch. Design and ship production web apps end to end — database schema, API layer, frontend UI, authentication, and deployment. These are greenfield builds, not maintenance of someone else's code. You own the product from concept to live, then iterate based on how the team actually uses it. 2. Own the infrastructure and DevOps. Stand up environments, manage deployments across dev/staging/production, handle environment configuration and secrets properly, and keep what you ship observable, reliable, and recoverable. You're comfortable deploying and managing web properties programmatically and at scale, and you understand how to integrate a stack of external APIs into one coherent system. 3. Engineer business-critical automations. Design, build, and maintain multi-step automation workflows that move data reliably between platforms — CRMs, ecommerce systems, project management tools, communication channels, and spreadsheets. You build the plumbing so that data, events, and alerts flow correctly, with error handling that doesn't fail silently. You will not be waiting for tickets. You'll be working with leadership to understand what needs to exist, then building it. Who you are You're a builder. You get energy from shipping things, not fro ---------- etings about shipping things. You have integrity and you finish what you start. When you say it's done, it's done. When something breaks, you raise your hand early instead of hiding it. You want a long-term home. You're looking to grow with one company over years, not stack short-term gigs. You're comfortable with ambiguity. "Here's the problem — figure out the best solution" excites you rather than stresses you. You context-switch well. You can write a React component in the morning and debug a webhook integration or a deployment issue in the afternoon. You're a self-starter. You research, troubleshoot, and find answers independently before escalating. Documentation, search, and AI tools are your first line of defense. You document and communicate. You write things down so others can maintain them, and you proactively share status — especially when something is blocked, broken, or behind. --- Required technical skills --- Full-Stack Development React / Next.js — Building production web applications from scratch (not just editing templates). TypeScript / JavaScript — Strong fundamentals, not copy-paste from search results. Backend & databases (SQL/Postgres) — Schema design, relationships, indexing, and writing efficient queries. Experience with a modern backend-as-a-service platform (e.g., Supabase or Firebase) including auth, row-level security, and serverless functions is a strong plus. REST APIs — Designing and consuming APIs, authentication patterns, pagination, and robust error handling. You should be comfortable integrating many third-party APIs into one system. Tailwind CSS / responsive UI — Clean, responsive interfaces that work across screen sizes. DevOps & Infrastructure Deployment & environments — Confidently take an app from your machine to production: build step, environment configuration, deploy target, verification, and a rollback plan. Environment variables & secrets — You never hardcode keys or commit secrets; you understand per-environment config. Containers — Working understanding of Docker and why consistent environments matter ("works on my machine" is a problem you know how to eliminate). Hosting platforms — Experience deploying and managing apps and web properties on modern platforms (e.g., Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar). Git — Version-control discipline: feature branches, small meaningful commits, pull requests, not pushing straight to main. Automation & Integration Engineering Workflow automation (n8n or equivalent) — Multi-step workflows including webhooks, scheduled jobs, branching logic, data transformation, retries, idempotency, and error handling. (n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom code — what matters is you understand the patterns.) Integrating SaaS platforms — Comfort connecting tools such as CRMs, ecommerce systems, project management, chat/messaging, and spreadsheets via their APIs and webhooks. You'll learn our specific stack quickly; the underlying skill is what we're hiring for. Data integrity — Deduplication, reconciliation, audit logging, and handling edge cases and out-of-order events so the same thing never gets processed twice. AI-Assisted Development Baseline familiarity required — You've used AI coding assistants (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) and understand how to prompt them, validate their output, and use them to ship faster without losing track of what you're actually building. Eagerness to go deep — You don't need elite-tier access today. We provide it, and we expect you to grow into power-user proficiency fast. Ability to evaluate and prototype AI-powered features is something you'll develop here with the best tools in the industry at your fingertips. --- Nice-to-have (not required) --- Experience deploying and managing large numbers of web properties or landing pages programmatically. Familiarity with search-infrastructure concepts: indexing, sitemaps, structured data/schema, and how content gets discovered and ranked. Building chatbots or conversational AI agents. WordPress custom API integrations or plugin development. Stripe or other payment-processing integrations. Familiarity with SEO tools and marketing-technology platforms. Experience modeling API costs at scale. --- What success looks like --- First 30 days Onboarded to our systems and toolchain, including AI development tools. Shipped at least one small tool or meaningful feature. Taken ownership of and stabilized existing automation workflows. Established a clear communication rhythm with leadership. First 90 days Your first full-stack application is in production and being used by the team. Critical automations are documented, monitored, and running reliably. You're proactively identifying and proposing improvements, not just executing. You're operating independently on day-to-day priorities. First 6 months Multiple tools shipped and iterating based on real usage. Infrastructure is reliable, observable, and well-documented. You've become the team's go-to for "how should we build this?" Your work has produced measurable time savings and operational improvements — and you're being trusted with bigger problems. --- Core responsibilities --- Application development Build web applications (frontend + API + database + auth) from concept to production. Own the full lifecycle: schema design, API development, UI, deployment, and ongoing iteration. Write clean, maintainable, documented code. Ship working prototypes first, then polish based on feedback. DevOps & reliability Manage deployment across dev, staging, and production with verification and rollback. Configure environments and manage secrets securely. Keep systems observable — logging, status visibility, and alerting so problems surface fast. Automation & integration Design and deploy multi-step automation workflows that synchronize data across business platforms. Implement robust error handling: retries, deduplication, dead-letter patterns, audit logging, and alerts on failure. Establish reusable patterns with consistent naming, standardized building blocks, and clean environment-variable management. Documentation & visibility Document workflows, system architecture, and runbooks. Build operational dashboards and status outputs so the team can see what's running. Maintain mapping and integration documentation as systems grow. Continuous improvement Evaluate and recommend tools and processes that make the team faster. Prototype new automation and AI-powered capabilities. --- Soft skills that matter here --- Self-directed problem solver — You exhaust documentation, search, and AI tools before escalating. Time management — You show up on time, hit deadlines, and flag slippage early. Strong written communication — You explain technical decisions clearly and write documentation others can follow. Ownership mentality — If you built it, you own it. Bugs, performance, uptime — yours until it's handed off. --- Work schedule & holidays --- All staff work a split shift so we can collaborate and meet with US leadership on pertinent tasks. We observe all US holidays as well as PH public holidays (New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Bataan Day, Labour Day, Philippine Independence Day, National Heroes' Day, Bonifacio Day, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Christmas Day, Rizal Day). We work hard and we value time with family. After a 90-day probationary period, all staff qualify for leave with proper notice per the employee handbook. --- Compensation --- Full-time, long-term position (this is a career role, not a contract gig). Typical monthly earnings of roughly $1,700–$2,100 USD for this role, depending on demonstrated knowledge, technical ability, and experience — with room to earn more as you take on greater responsibility. Performance-based increases as your scope and impact grow. We promote and pay from within as the company scales. --- Perks & benefits --- Elite AI development tooling, paid for by us — top-tier AI coding assistants and automation platforms most engineers never get to use. This is how you grow your skill set fastest. Paid access to the development platforms and API subscriptions you'll build on. Paid training and courses for professional development. Direct access to company leadership — your ideas get heard and shipped fast. The chance to architect and build products from the ground up, not maintain someone else's code. A small team where your contributions are visible and valued. A clear path to increased responsibility and compensation as we grow. --- How to apply --- Do not send a generic application. We will ignore it. We're looking for one person to grow with us long-term, and how you apply tells us a lot about how you work. Please include: A brief introduction (video recording) — Who you are, what you've built recently, and why a long-term role here interests you. A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or shipped work — We want to see things you've actually built and deployed, not tutorial projects. Your experience with AI-assisted development — Which tools you've used, how they fit into your workflow, and one specific example of how they helped you ship faster or better. (No elite-tier access yet? Tell us how you'd use it if you had it.) One question about the role — This tells us you actually read the posting. description: We're Hiring: Social Media Content Production Specialist (Part-Time) Help Us Bring Hope and Healing to Thousands Around the World Do you love creating meaningful social media content? Are you skilled with Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, and short-form video creation?Would you enjoy helping build a Christian ministry dedicated to emotional healing, healthy relationships, and hope after heartbreak? If so, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT US: Healed To Love Again is a Christian ministry committed to helping people heal from heartbreak, recover emotionally, strengthen their faith, and prepare for healthier future relationships. Through social media, books, podcasts, articles, and other digital resources, we share practical and biblically grounded encouragement with people around the world. As our ministry grows, we're looking for someone who can become an important part of our long-term content team. ABOUT THE POSITION - This Is NOT a Traditional Virtual Assistant Role - We are not looking for someone to simply upload posts or perform administrative tasks. - Instead, we're looking for someone who can take our ideas and transform them into engaging, high-quality social media content. - Think of yourself as part of our Content Production Team. - You won't be expected to invent our message. Our founders will provide: * Weekly content topics * Key teaching points * Supporting Bible verses * Emotional direction * Brand guidelines Your role is to transform those ideas into beautiful, engaging content. WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK Every Monday, you'll attend a short planning meeting where you'll receive five content topics for the week. For each topic, you'll create: - One short-form Reel (Facebook / Instagram / TikTok) - One quote graphic in Canva - One social media post - One Story sequence After approval, you'll: - Schedule content across our platforms - Organize project files - Update the content calendar - Prepare a simple weekly analytics report You'll also help us improve our content system over time by suggesting workflow improvements and using tools effectively. TOOLS YOU'LL USE We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI and modern content creation tools. Preferred experience includes: * ChatGPT * Canva * CapCut * Google Drive * Meta Business Suite * TikTok Scheduler Experience with Notion or Trello is a bonus. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for someone who is: * Creative * Organized * Reliable * Detail-oriented * Comfortable using AI * Willing to learn * Able to meet deadlines * Open to feedback * Interested in building long-term systems rather than simply completing tasks REQUIRED SKILLS * Excellent written English * Canva * CapCut * Basic graphic design * Short-form video editing * Social media copywriting * ChatGPT prompting * Content organization BONUS SKILLS Experience creating content for: * Christian ministries * Coaches * Authors * Personal brands * Relationship or mental wellness organizations is an advantage but not required. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Every Friday, the following should be ready: - 5 completed Reels - 5 quote graphics - 5 social media posts - 5 Story sequences - All content scheduled - Organized project files - Weekly analytics summary As our systems improve, you'll also help us make our content production faster, smarter, and more efficient. TRAINING & SUPPORT You won't be starting from scratch. We've already built detailed systems that you'll receive, including: * Brand Guidelines * Content Production SOPs * Weekly Content Briefs * AI Prompt Library * Canva Templates * CapCut Templates * Content Calendar * Workflow Documentation Our goal is to help you succeed by providing clear systems and expectations. COMPENSATION * Part-time position * Approximately 5–6 hours per week * Competitive hourly rate based on experience There is opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the ministry grows. OUR HIRING PROCESS Our hiring process is in the following states Stage 1 – Application, Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment and Stage 3 – Interview Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week Stage 1 – Application Please submit: 1. Your resume. 2. A link to your portfolio or examples of your work. Examples may include: * Reels * Short-form videos * Canva graphics * Social media pages you've managed 3. Briefly tell us about your experience using: * ChatGPT * Canva * CapCut * Facebook * Instagram * TikTok 4. In 200 words or less: How has AI changed the way you create content? title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
job_title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: VA Sales Specialist Fitness
description: JOB TITLE: Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant — Inbound Closer + B2B Hunter for Premium Fitness Studios (Base + Uncapped Commission) JOB OVERVIEW: We are a premium fitness company operating TWO studio locations in California, anchored by expert personal training and complemented by boxing, yoga, strength training, and calisthenics. We are hiring a Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant to be our dedicated closer across BOTH locations — owning every lead from first touch to signed membership, AND proactively building a B2B pipeline for corporate wellness and group programs. This is a high-leverage role: two studios, two lead pools, two markets — and uncapped commission across all of it. If you are a hunter who loves the phone, the close, and the commission check, keep reading. If you are looking for a "sit back and reply to email s" job, this is NOT for you. ------------------------------------------------------------ WORKING HOURS ------------------------------------------------------------ Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (US). This is non-negotiable — it covers our peak lead and member-acquisition window across both locations. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION — BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION ------------------------------------------------------------ BASE SALARY: USD $600 per month, paid bi-monthly via Wise or Payoneer. COMMISSION STRUCTURE — PERCENTAGE-BASED, UNCAPPED: TIER A — PERSONAL TRAINING PACKAGES (our flagship service) 8% of the total contract value of every PT package you close. Examples: - 3-month PT package at $1,800 sold:    $144 commission - 6-month PT package at $3,600 sold:    $288 commission - 12-month PT package at $7,200 sold:   $576 commission - Premium custom PT ($10,000+):         $800+ commission TIER B — GROUP STUDIO MEMBERSHIPS (Boxing, Yoga, Strength, Calisthenics) 6% of the first 12 months of contract value on every new membership you close. Examples: - Month-to-month at $179/mo (12 mo value = $2,148):    $129 commission - 6-month commitment at $159/mo ($1,908 value):        $115 commission - 12-month commitment at $139/mo ($1,668 value):       $100 commission TIER C — B2B / CORPORATE WELLNESS — THE BIG MONEY TIER 12% of total contract value on every B2B deal you source AND close. This is corporate wellness packages, team training, group programs for companies, executive PT for C-suite teams, and any business-to-business contract. Examples: - 10-employee corporate wellness package at $8,000:    $960 commission - 25-employee team training program at $20,000:        $2,400 commission - Annual corporate retainer at $36,000:                $4,320 commission We are based in the Bay Area / Silicon Valley — tech companies, startups, and professional firms within 25 miles are all in play. The B2B pipeline is wide open. Whoever builds it wins. TIER D — PIPELINE-BUILDING BONUSES (paid even before the close) - $5 per fully qualified inbound opportunity added to the pipeline (BANT-qualified: budget confirmed, decision-maker reached, timeline established, fit confirmed). - $25 per booked B2B discovery call (verified decision-maker, company size 25+ employees, scheduled on a real calendar). - $100 milestone bonus when you source, qualify, AND close a B2B deal entirely on your own outreach. TIER E — MONTHLY VOLUME BONUSES (stack on top of all commission above) - 10+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$100 bonus - 20+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$300 bonus - 30+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$800 bonus TIER F — MULTI-LOCATION BONUS - $100 monthly bonus when KPIs are hit across BOTH studio locations. REALISTIC EARNING POTENTIAL: With two studios feeding the pipeline and B2B in play, a strong closer can realistically earn USD $2,000–$4,500 in commission per month ON TOP of base. Top performers who land 1–2 B2B deals per quarter can exceed USD $5,000/month in total compensation. Uncapped. Period. PAYMENT TERMS: - Base paid on the 1st and 15th. - Commission paid the month following the close, after the customer's first payment clears. - Pipeline bonuses paid monthly with base. - 14-day clawback window if a sale is refunded. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU WILL DO ------------------------------------------------------------ INBOUND SALES (across both locations) - Respond to every inbound lead within 5 minutes during your shift — SMS, email , DM, phone. - Qualify leads using our discovery framework. - Book or close — your call based on the lead's heat. - Run discovery calls, present the right package, handle objections, close the sale. - Send agreements via DocuSign and follow up until signed and paid. NURTURE & RECOVERY - Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 manual follow-up sequence on every unconverted lead. - Re-engage cold leads from the last 12 months. - Win back churned members from the last 6 months. B2B OUTBOUND PIPELINE-BUILDING (high-leverage) - Build a target list of 100+ Bay Area companies (25–500 employees) within 10 miles of our locations. - Cold outreach via LinkedIn, email , and phone to HR leaders, People Ops, and Founders. - Pitch corporate wellness, team training, executive PT, and group programs. - Book discovery calls on the owners' calendar. - Own the deal cycle from first touch to signed contract. CRM HYGIENE & REPORTING - Real-time pipeline updates across both locations. - Weekly sales report every Friday: leads, calls, consults, deals closed, commission earned, B2B pipeline status. ------------------------------------------------------------ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ------------------------------------------------------------ ENGLISH: - Fluent, near-native spoken and written English. - NEUTRAL ACCENT REQUIRED — must sound clear and professional to American customers, including corporate decision-makers. Your audio sample (see "How to Apply") is the first thing we review. SALES EXPERIENCE: - Minimum 2 years of phone-based sales experience. - Strong preference for: fitness sales, gy ---------- mberships, personal training sales, wellness, beauty, med spa, real estate, insurance, or high-ticket B2C closing. - B2B experience is a major plus. - Proven track record hitting quota — be ready to share specific numbers. PERSONALITY: - Friendly. People should feel like you actually care, because you do. - Dynamic. High-energy, naturally enthusiastic, the kind of voice that makes someone smile through the phone. - Resilient. Rejection sharpens you, not breaks you. - Hungry. You want the commission and you'll do the work to earn it. - Coachable. Feedback is fuel. TECHNICAL: - Comfortable on Zoom, Google Meet, MindBody / GHL / similar CRM, DocuSign, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Slack. - Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps). - Quiet workspace, zero background noise during calls. - Working webcam, professional-grade headset (not laptop speakers, not earbuds). - Modern computer running smoothly. PREFERRED (BONUS — NOT REQUIRED): - Personal experience as a gy ---------- mber, PT client, or fitness enthusiast. - Familiarity with the US fitness market and Bay Area / California consumer mindset. - Prior B2B prospecting or cold outreach experience. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO WILL HATE THIS JOB ------------------------------------------------------------ - People afraid of the phone. - People who hate cold outreach. - People who don't want their performance measured in numbers. - People who think 12–8 PM Pacific is "too late" (3 AM – 11 AM Manila — yes, schedule shift required). - People who want a flat hourly rate with no upside. - People who think "sales" is a dirty word. title: SEO / AEO Full-Stack Specialist
description: # SEO / AEO Full-Stack Specialist **Company:** Moredemand **Location:** Remote (UK-based preferred) **Type:** Full-time --- ## The Role We're hiring a full-stack SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) specialist to own organic visibility across a portfolio of brands spanning SaaS, regulated financial services, and personal brand properties. This isn't a "write meta titles and build links" role. The search landscape has fundamentally shifted. Google is embedding AI overviews. ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude are becoming primary research tools for buyers. The line between ranking on a SERP and being cited by an LLM is disappearing — and we need someone who operates across both. You'll be responsible for making sure our brands show up wherever people and machines are looking for answers — traditional search, AI-generated responses, voice, and conversational discovery. --- ## What You'll Own **Search Engine Optimisation** - Technical SEO across multiple Next.js and WordPress properties — crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internal linking architecture - Keyword strategy and content planning tied directly to commercial intent and funnel stage - On-page optimisation at scale — not just blog posts, but landing pages, tool pages, comparison pages, and programmatic content - Link acquisition strategy that doesn't rely on guest post spam — digital PR, data-led content, strategic partnerships - Reporting and forecasting that connects organic traffic to pipeline and revenue, not just impressions **Answer Engine Optimisation** - Structuring content and site architecture so LLMs can accurately extract, attribute, and cite our brands - Schema markup, entity optimisation, and knowledge graph presence - Monitoring brand representation across AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot) - Building topical authority signals that influence how AI models categorise and recommend our products - Testing and iterating on content formats that perform in both traditional and AI-driven discovery **Full-Stack Execution** - You can brief writers, but you can also build pages. Comfortable working in code (HTML, CSS, basic JS/React) to implement changes without waiting on a dev queue - Able to spin up landing pages, adjust templates, deploy schema, and configure CMS structures independently - Data analysis in GA4, Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, and custom dashboards — pulling insight, not just reporting numbers - Comfortable with AI tooling in your own workflow — using Claude, GPT, or similar to accelerate research, content production, and technical audits --- ## What We're Looking For - 3+ years in SEO with demonstrable commercial results (traffic that turned into revenue, not just rankings) - Working knowledge of AEO principles — even if the discipline is new, you should already be thinking about how AI search changes the game - Technical competence — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be able to read and edit code, work with APIs, and implement changes in a codebase without hand-holding - Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, legal) is a strong advantage — you understand what YMYL means in practice, not just in theory - Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of demand capture and conversion, not just traffic volume - Self-directed and low-maintenance — we operate lean and move fast, you won't have a manager checking in daily --- ## The Stack - **Sites:** Next.js (App Router), WordPress - **Hosting:** Vercel, Cloudflare - **Analytics:** GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, custom dashboards - **Content:** Claude API, Notion, markdown-first workflows - **Dev:** GitHub, VS Code, Claude Code - **CRM/Data:** PostgreSQL, Stripe, Clerk --- ## What You Get - Direct ownership of organic and AI discovery across a portfolio doing real volume (500,000+ customers acquired through paid — now building the organic engine to match) - Exposure to SaaS product development, regulated financial services, and personal brand growth — not a single-vertical silo - A founder who understands marketing at a technical level — you won't be explaining what a canonical tag is - Autonomy to build the playbook, not just follow one - Competitive salary based on experience, with performance-based upside --- ## How to Apply Send a short note (not a cover letter essay) explaining: 1. One organic growth result you're genuinely proud of — what you did, what moved, and why it mattered commercially 2. Your take on how AI search changes SEO strategy over the next 12–18 months 3. A link to something you've built or optimised that we can look at Send to: ** [email address]** No agencies. No "I'd love to connect" LinkedIn messages. Just the work.

title: Financial Controller
description: About the Role We are a U.S.-based healthcare services company looking for a hands-on Controller to own our accounting close and financial reporting, bring our books to a state we can rely on, and lead a small, capable remote finance and operations team. Today, most of our day-to-day operations run through an interconnected set of Google Sheets, while financial transactions are recorded in QuickBooks Online. We want a controller who can make QuickBooks the source of truth for financial reporting—producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet every month—while keeping our Google Sheets running smoothly as operational tools. This is a role for someone who is both a strong accountant and a capable manager: comfortable making categorization and accounting judgment calls independently, and equally comfortable directing, reviewing, and developing a team. Key Responsibilities Accounting & Monthly Close Own the monthly close and produce timely, accurate financial statements (P&L and balance sheet) in QuickBooks Online. Establish and maintain QuickBooks as the company's financial source of truth, with Google Sheets used operationally. Maintain the chart of accounts, class structure, and cost-of-goods-sold framework; make and document categorization decisions independently rather than escalating routine ones. Prepare and post journal entries, including payroll allocations and owner draws/distributions. Reconcile all funding channels: bank deposits, merchant processors, financing partners, ACH, and checks. Cash Flow & Payroll Prepare the weekly cash-flow forecast every Wednesday by 8:00 AM, covering transacted-but-undeposited revenue across all channels and upcoming obligations (payroll, vendors, financing). Prepare and review weekly payroll for submission to our payroll processor. Final sign-off remains with ownership; you ensure it is accurate and ready. Track commissions, bonuses, reserves, deferrals, and clawbacks accurately and transparently. Expense Management & Internal Controls Review corporate card activity against receipts and policy; flag personal or unapproved charges and manage clawbacks. Build and enforce expense and card-usage policies, including documentation and approval standards. Track refunds and chargebacks; put controls in place to prevent duplicate or erroneous refunds. Oversee accounts receivable and collections, including payment follow-ups and tracking of uncollected sales. Systems & Data Integrity Maintain and safeguard our Google Sheets architecture (rep workbooks, master sales sheet, weekly P&L/payroll, cash-flow analysis, bonus and scoring trackers), including formula integrity, cross-sheet links, and range protection. Standardize recurring processes and document clear SOPs. Help evaluate and, where feasible, support a future migration of recordkeeping toward more integrated tooling or a CRM. Team Leadership Manage, direct, and develop a three-person remote finance/operations team. Assign and prioritize work, review deliverables for accuracy and completeness, and ensure deadlines are met. Establish and monitor productivity and time-tracking standards; hold the team accountable for both hours worked and output delivered. Serve as the first point of resolution for day-to-day questions, reducing escalations to ownership. Reporting & Stakeholders Produce financial reports for ownership and, when needed, for prospective partners or lenders. Communicate proactively and clearly in writing, primarily via Slack and email . What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) QuickBooks cleaned up to the point of producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet. Reliable weekly cash-flow forecast and payroll, with minimal ownership involvement in routine categorization. A documented categorization ruleset and a basic internal-controls/expense-policy framework. A clear, accurate handle on team workload, output quality, and hours. Required Qualifications 5+ years of progressive accounting/bookkeeping experience, including ownership of a monthly close. Advanced QuickBooks Online skills (chart of accounts, classes, journal entries, COGS). Strong Google Sheets ability: complex formulas (e.g., QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA) and the ability to debug and maintain a system of linked workbooks. Demonstrated experience managing a team (remote experience preferred). Excellent written English and a schedule with significant overlap with U.S. business hours. High integrity, strong attention to detail, and a proactive, ownership mindset. Preferred (Nice to Have) CPA (Philippine CPA) or equivalent credential. U.S. GAAP familiarity (accrual accounting, contra-revenue, COGS treatment). Experience with payroll processors (e.g., ADP), AP/AR and ACH platforms (e.g., ---------- ), corporate card platforms (e.g., Divvy, Amex), and merchant/financing processors. Experience evaluating or implementing a CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel). Tools You'll Use QuickBooks Online · Google Sheets · ADP · ---------- · Divvy · Amex · Care Credit/Synchrony · Chase Payment Solutions · Wise · Slack Reporting & Authority Reports directly to ownership. Manages the three-person finance/operations team. Prepares and reviews payroll; final payroll sign-off and all expenditure approvals remain with ownership.
