title: Hatchery Operations Manager
description: Mudcrab Hatchery Operations Manager Location: Himamaylan, Negros Occidental Reports To: Farm Owner Employment Type: Full-Time, Operational (requires on-call availability) About the Role: We are seeking a master of metamorphosis. This is not a routine farm management position; it is a highly specialized, science-driven role responsible for the most delicate phase of the mudcrab lifecycle. The Hatchery Operations Manager will orchestrate the entire hatchery process, from broodstock maturation to the delivery of healthy, robust crablets (megalopa/crabeon stage). You will blend deep knowledge of decapod biology with industrial facility management to solve a singular, critical challenge: reliably producing life at scale. Key Responsibilities: 1. Production Mastery & Larval Rearing Broodstock & Spawning: Manage the entire reproductive cycle, including broodstock selection, health assessment, conditioning, and spawning induction (including unilateral eyestalk ablation where applicable) of Scylla serrata and related species. Larval Lifecycle Management: Oversee the critical and fragile transition through all zoea stages (Z1-Z5) to megalopa and finally to crabelet. This includes managing metamorphosis, identifying staging in real-time, and adjusting protocols instantly. Live Feed Command: Direct the high-density, axenic (zero-contamination) production of the entire live feed chain—intensive microalgae (Nannochloropsis, Chaetoceros, Tetraselmis), rotifers (Brachionus), and Artemia—with a focus on targeted enrichment profiles (e.g., HUFA, Vitamin C) for each larval stage. 2. Industrial Systems & Water Quality Management Life Support Systems: Assume ownership of all Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and flow-through infrastructure. This includes hands-on troubleshooting and preventative maintenance of pumps, biofilters, protein skimmers, UV sterilizers, heaters/chillers, and emergency backup systems. Parameter Precision: Maintain a non-negotiable, 24/7 stable environment by monitoring and reacting to critical parameters: temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrite, and alkalinity. Calibrate automated probes against manual titration methods regularly. 3. Biosecurity & Veterinary Health Disease Prevention: Act as the first line of defense. Implement and enforce a fortress-style biosecurity plan to prevent catastrophic events from pathogens like luminous vibriosis, Lagenidium fungus, and ciliates. Health Diagnostics: Perform daily microscopic health checks on larvae, identify early signs of stress, bacterial blooms, or necrosis, and execute rapid, decisive treatment protocols. Sanitation Protocols: Enforce rigorous dry-out, disinfection, and sterilization cycles for all tanks, equipment, and facilities between production runs. 4. Data, Science, and Continuous Improvement Forensic Record-Keeping: Maintain a meticulous, "black box" of data for every production run: survival rates by stage, daily feeding regimes, water chemistry logs, and growth metrics. This data is used to diagnose failures and replicate success. R&D for Cannibalism Mitigation: Lead ongoing applied research trials to crack the code on the megalopa-to-crablet bottleneck. This includes innovating with shelter designs (substrates, mesh structures), optimizing stocking densities, and manipulating environmental cues to reduce aggressive behavior and maximize survival. 5. Leadership & Emergency Response Team Leadership: Train and lead a small, dedicated team of technicians. Instill a culture of precision, cleanliness, and acute observation. Crisis Management: This is a 24/7 life-support operation. The manager must be mentally prepared to wake up, diagnose a failing pump, a drop in dissolved oxygen, or a disease outbreak, and make life-or-death decisions for millions of animals under extreme pressure. Candidate Profile: Are You One of the Few? Essential Technical Mastery Decapod Science: Deep, applied understanding of crustacean endocrinology, molting physiology, and nutritional pathology. Aquatic Engineering: You can rebuild a pump, wire a float switch, sweat PVC pipe, and diagnose a short-circuited blower. You are as comfortable with a wrench as with a microscope. Microscopic Eye: You can quickly identify a healthy Z3 larva from a bacterially infected one, and spot the difference between a rotifer and a ciliate bloom under a scope. Required Background Education: BSc or MSc in Aquaculture, Marine Biology, or related field. A proven track record can substitute for a degree. Experience: Minimum 5+ years in a marine hatchery, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Specialized Track Record: Must have direct, verifiable, hands-on experience closing the lifecycle of a decapod crustacean (mudcrab, swimming crab, shrimp/prawn). Experience with Scylla is the gold standard. Personal Attributes The "Biological Clock": You have an intuitive sense for the rhythm of a hatchery; you "feel" when something is wrong before the alarms go off. Resilient Problem-Solver: You remain calm and logical when a production run crashes, immediately shifting to root-cause analysis and solution mode. Guardian of Biosecurity: You have a slightly obsessive mindset about cleanliness and contamination control.

Leadership is genuinely invested in finding better ways to do things, and we expect the same mindset from everyone on the team. A Note on Honesty We value honesty over impressive claims. Please don't tell us you're an expert in something you've only read about or briefly touched. It's okay to say "I've used AppFolio a few times but I'm not an expert" or "I haven't handled evictions before but I'm willing to learn." We will find out the truth — whether it's during the assessment, the interview, or the first week on the job. And when we do, it damages trust that's very hard to rebuild. We would much rather hire someone who says "I don't know that yet, but I'll learn it" than someone who claims to know everything and can't deliver. Being humble, honest about where you are, and willing to put in the work to grow — that's what gets you far here. We have the training, the runbooks, and the team support to get the right person up to speed. What we can't teach is integrity. We're actively expanding our portfolio and our team. title: Podcast Booking Agent
description: **Full-Time Podcast & Partnerships Booker For Online Course / Coaching Company** We are looking for an experienced, proactive and highly organised outreach specialist to help us get in front of new audiences every week. Marketplace SuperHeroes is an online education company that teaches everyday people how to build practical online income streams by selling products on online marketplaces, such as Amazon and Whatnot, as well as other side-income models. We have been in business for over 12 years, have served thousands of customers, and are now building a dedicated traffic partnerships team. This role is for someone who can help book Lisa (CEO) and Stephen (founder) from our company onto relevant podcasts, interviews, websites, blogs, newsletters, online communities and sponsorship opportunities. The goal is simple: we want to get in front of audiences who are interested in side hustles, online income, business opportunities, personal finance, personal development, financial freedom and business education. This is not a basic admin role. We need someone who can think, research properly, write strong outreach messages, follow up professionally, track everything clearly and keep improving the system over time. **What you will be doing each day** Your main focus will be booking podcast interviews for Lisa and Stephen. This will include researching relevant podcasts, finding the right contact details, checking that the audience is a good fit, writing personalised pitches, following up, managing replies, coordinating interview times, adding bookings to the calendar, and keeping the team updated. You will also spend part of your time researching and pitching written traffic opportunities. This may include sponsored blog posts, written interviews, website features, banner ads, newsletter sponsorships, podcast sponsorships, paid newsletter drops, influencer partnerships, and other ways we can get in front of the right audience. We are building this as a real traffic channel, so you will not just be “sending email s.” You will be helping us build a repeatable system for finding, pitching, booking and tracking new audience opportunities. **Your responsibilities will include the following** You will research podcasts that speak to our ideal audience. You will find podcast hosts, producers, website owners, newsletter owners and partnership contacts. You will write personalised outreach messages that sound human, relevant and professional. You will pitch Lisa and Stephen as guests for podcast interviews, written interviews and expert features. You will pitch sponsorship opportunities where our business can pay to be featured in front of the right audience. You will follow up consistently without being spammy or robotic. You will coordinate bookings, calendar times, links, bios, headshots, topics and any assets needed. You will maintain a clear tracker showing who has been contacted, when they were contacted, their status, next follow-up date and outcome. You will report your results clearly every week. You will help improve the outreach scripts, research process and reporting system as we learn what works. You will look for ways to increase booked interviews, confirmed promotions, sponsored placements and partner opportunities over time. **The right person for this role will have the following experience** You must have previous experience with podcast booking, influencer outreach, partnership outreach, sponsorship outreach or a very similar role. You must have excellent written and spoken English. You must be able to write messages that sound natural, personal and persuasive. You must be very organised and comfortable tracking your work in spreadsheets or project management tools. You must be self-motivated and able to work without being chased. You must be good at researching and understanding whether an audience is relevant. You must be comfortable using tools like Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Calendar, ChatGPT, LinkedIn, Instagram, podcast directories and website research tools. You must be willing to learn our business, our offers, our audience and our voice. You must be reliable, consistent and honest in your reporting. You must not send generic copy-and-paste pitches to everyone. **This role is not for you if any of the following are true** You need to be told every single step every day. You apply to jobs with generic AI-written applications. You have never done outreach before. You are uncomfortable following up with people. You do not like tracking numbers. You cannot write in clear, natural English. You only want simple admin tasks. **What success looks like** Each week, we want to see clear activity and clear outcomes. We will be tracking the number of relevant podcasts researched, the number of quality pitches sent, the number of follow-ups sent, the number of replies received, the number of podcast interviews booked, the number of sponsorship opportunities found, the number of website or blog features booked, and the number of confirmed promotional opportunities. We care about quality as much as quantity. It is better to find 50 highly relevant opportunities than 500 random websites that make no sense for our business. This is very important. **The work schedule** This is a full-time role. The role will be approximately 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday. The first half of the day will usually be focused on podcast booking and interview coordination. The second half of the day will usually be focused on blogs, websites, newsletters, sponsorships and other traffic partnership opportunities. You will need to have some overlap with UK/Ireland business hours so we can communicate properly. We are looking for someone long-term. We will start with a paid trial period so we can make sure the role is a good fit for both sides. **How to apply** Please reply with the word “TRAFFIC” at the top of your application. Please include a short summary of your relevant experience. Please include examples of podcast booking, PR outreach, guest posting, influencer outreach, sponsorship outreach or partnership outreach work you have done before. Please include 2 podcasts you think could be a good fit for Marketplace SuperHeroes and briefly explain why. Generic applications will not be considered.

title: Paid Media Manager (PPC)
description: Job Description Paid Media Manager (PPC) About Intellezy Intellezy helps organizations upskill their teams with a training video library, custom eLearning, and AI adoption services. We’re a lean, high-output team where great work gets noticed and every role has direct impact on growth. The Role We’re looking for a Paid Media Manager who can own our PPC program end-to-end, from strategy and budget management to campaign execution, testing, and reporting. Google Ads is our primary channel, with Meta and LinkedIn playing supporting roles as we scale lead generation. This is a high-ownership role. You’ll manage paid media as a direct driver of qualified pipeline, with the autonomy to build, test, and optimize campaigns across channels. As the program grows and performance goals are met, there is clear opportunity for performance-based bonuses tied to lead volume and closed revenue. What You’ll Do • Strategy & Budget Management ? Own the paid media roadmap across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Meta (Facebook /Instagram), LinkedIn, and additional channels as needed. ? Manage and allocate budget across channels to maximize qualified lead volume and pipeline contribution. ? Set and track spend pacing, CPA targets, and ROAS benchmarks; report regularly to the Marketing Manager. ? Identify new channel and audience opportunities to expand reach among L&D buyers, HR leaders, and training decision-makers. • Campaign Execution & Optimization ? Build and manage campaigns from the ground up: keyword research, audience targeting, ad copy, bidding strategy, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking. ? Run structured A/B tests on ad creative, copy, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages to continuously improve performance. ? Optimize campaigns based on performance data: adjust bids, pause underperformers, scale winners, and refine targeting regularly. ? Ensure accurate conversion tracking across all channels via Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, and platform-native tools. • Google Ads (Primary Channel) ? Manage Search campaigns with strong keyword strategy: match types, negative keyword hygiene, intent-based ad groups, and Quality Score optimization. ? Build and test ad copy, extensions, and landing page messaging for different audience segments and offers. ? Leverage Performance Max, Display, and remarketing campaigns to support full-funnel coverage. • Meta & LinkedIn Ads ? Run LinkedIn campaigns targeting L&D, HR, and training buyer personas using job title, industry, company size, and skills-based targeting. ? Execute Meta campaigns for awareness, retargeting, and lead generation; build and test custom and lookalike audiences. ? Develop ad creative briefs and work with design/content to produce high-performing assets. • Reporting & Analytics ? Deliver regular performance reports covering spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, conversion rate, CPL, and pipeline influence. ? Maintain clean attribution and UTM hygiene across all campaigns; monitor performance in GA4, HubSpot, and platform dashboards. ? Translate performance data into clear recommendations and present findings to the Marketing Manager. What You’ve Done (Qualifications) • 3–6 years of hands-on paid media experience with a documented track record of generating B2B leads via Google Ads. Be prepared to walk through real campaign performance data, not just describe past roles. • Deep Google Ads expertise: Search, Display, Performance Max, remarketing, and conversion tracking. Google Ads certification a plus. • Solid experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager for B2B demand generation; experience with Meta Ads Manager for lead gen and retargeting. Examples of audience strategies and results welcome. • Comfortable managing budgets, setting performance targets, and reporting ROI to stakeholders. • Proficient in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot (or comparable CRM/marketing automation platform). • Strong analytical mindset: you can read data, identify what’s working, and act on it quickly. • Experience writing clear, conversion-focused ad copy; able to brief designers and collaborate on creative assets. • Bonus: Experience in B2B, eLearning, HR tech, or professional services; familiarity with the L&D buyer landscape. How We’ll Measure Success (KPIs) • Qualified lead volume from paid channels and cost-per-lead (CPL) against targets. • Pipeline contribution: paid-attributed opportunities and influenced revenue. • Channel efficiency: ROAS, conversion rate improvements, and budget utilization across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. • Testing velocity: number of structured A/B tests run per quarter and learnings implemented. Compensation & Growth Base compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. This role includes a performance-based bonus structure tied to lead generation volume and closed revenue from paid channels: as the program delivers, you share in the results. Tools You’ve Used Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, HubSpot, Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets for reporting, and creative tools for ad asset collaboration. Work Style • Entrepreneurial and results-driven: you treat the budget like it’s your own and are motivated by what the numbers say. • Detail-oriented with strong organizational habits; you never let a campaign run without checking performance. • Clear communicator who can translate paid media performance into business context for non-specialists. • Collaborative partner to Marketing, Sales, and Creative; you build campaigns that connect to the full buyer journey. Why Intellezy • Mission-driven team improving how people learn at work. • High-ownership role with direct visibility into pipeline and revenue impact. • Performance bonus potential tied to real business outcomes. • Supportive culture, competitive compensation, and flexible remote work. Location: Remote Team: Marketing Reports to: Marketing Manager *We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

title: Growth & Marketing Manager

We are a premier executive and organizational coaching firm dedicated to unlocking the highest potential of individuals, startups, and established teams. We operate with a collaborative, democratic culture where modern techniques, mindfulness, and strategic innovation meet. Role Summary: As the Growth & Marketing Manager at PGS, you will lead the strategic planning and hands-on execution of marketing initiatives across multiple brands. We are looking for a hybrid strategist and doer who can manage creative teams, optimize marketing funnels, and drive tangible business growth. Key Dimensions of the Role: Strategy & Execution: Seamlessly shift between high-level campaign planning and day-to-day execution. Team Leadership: Coordinate and empower a creative team of designers, content creators, and community managers. Growth & Business Development: Drive lead generation and build strategic partnerships to support business growth. Growth Strategy & Campaign Planning: The candidate will architect and execute full-funnel growth initiatives across the brand portfolio. Expected capabilities include: Strategic Planning: Architect comprehensive monthly and quarterly marketing roadmaps aligned with overarching business objectives. Launch Frameworks: Design and execute end-to-end launch strategies for mobile applications, digital services, and online communities. Audience Segmentation: Clearly define and analyze target audience personas for each unique brand. Multi-Stakeholder Campaigns: Develop targeted growth campaigns to attract and retain diverse segments, including users, B2B clients, strategic partners, and community members. Omnichannel Growth: Identify, test, and optimize high-impact growth channels, including LinkedIn, email marketing, webinars, podcasts, SEO, strategic partnerships, and community ecosystems. Tailored Consultations: Formulate data-driven growth recommendations customized to each brand’s specific audience dynamics and underlying business model. 2. Brand Positioning: The candidate will act as a brand custodian to ensure market differentiation and messaging consistency. Expected capabilities include: Identity Management: Clarify, establish, and systematically maintain the unique positioning and competitive advantage of each brand. Cross-Vertical Adaptability: Seamlessly adapt and shift brand messaging frameworks across highly diverse platforms, including faith-based, corporate business, health & wellness, and community-centric verticals. 3. Content Direction: The candidate will oversee content strategy to ensure all creative outputs directly fuel brand growth and audience acquisition. Key responsibilities include: Editorial Leadership: Own and manage the master content calendar across various platforms. Strategic Ideation: Translate high-level business and revenue goals into cohesive, actionable monthly and quarterly content themes. Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with and direct multi-disciplinary creative teams, including content creators, copywriters, graphic designers, and video editors. Quality & Alignment Assurance: Review and approve creative assets to guarantee absolute alignment with brand voice, standards, and values. Asset Repurposing: Maximize content ROI by repurposing long-form foundational ideas into high-performing social posts, email s, articles, reels, newsletters, and lead magnets. Performance-Driven Content: Ensure all published content is engineered to drive meaningful engagement, high-quality leads, platform signups, or active community participation. 4. Community Growth: In close collaboration with the Community Manager, the candidate will drive the expansion, activation, and monetization of our brand ecosystems. Key responsibilities include: Launch Strategies: Build tactical community launch plans designed to capture immediate interest. Engagement Campaigns: Design and implement sustainable engagement campaigns that keep communities vibrant and active. Event Activation: Support and optimize group discussions, digital events, educational webinars, and live streaming sessions. Lifecycle Mapping: Map and define optimal member journeys from initial onboarding to brand advocacy. Participation Frameworks: Implement strategic initiatives that continuously boost daily and weekly community participation. Product Adoption: Support beta-user recruitment strategies for new application rollouts. Ecosystem Monetization: Design strategies to convert highly engaged community members into paid subscribers, service clients, or program participants where appropriate. 5. Lead Generation & Funnels The candidate must possess a deep, sophisticated understanding of full-funnel marketing strategy. They will be expected to architect, manage, and optimize: Conversion Architecture: High-converting landing pages and compelling lead magnet frameworks. Automated Nurturing: Behavior-triggered email nurture sequences and drip campaigns. Event-Driven Funnels: High-value webinar and live event registration funnels. Sales Pipeline Support: Automated discovery call and consultation scheduling funnels. Product & Platform Onboarding: Frictionless mobile app signup funnels, waitlists, and interactive product launches. Subscriber Growth: Organic and paid newsletter growth strategies. Viral Loops: Viral referral marketing campaigns and collaborative partner initiatives. 6. Partnerships & Outreach: The candidate will actively support business development by identifying, securing, and fostering strategic B2B partnerships across diverse sectors, including: Entrepreneurs & Visionaries: Small business owners and professional coaches. Faith & Purpose Institutions: Churches, ministries, and faith-based communities. Thought Leaders: Authors, publishers, and content networks. Wellness & Lifestyle: Mental health, wellness, and self-reflection communities. Impact Organizations: Nonprofits, NGOs, and purpose-driven foundations. Growth Ecosystems: Strategic referral partners, industry associations, and niche professional communities. Media & PR: Podcast collaborations, joint webinars, and co-hosted digital events. 7. Marketing Performance & Reporting: The candidate must be highly data-literate and comfortable monitoring, analyzing, and synthesizing performance metrics, including: Acquisition & Growth: Total leads generated, email list velocity, website traffic, and organic community growth. Conversion Analytics: Platform conversion rates, application signups, and event registrations. Campaign Health: Multi-channel campaign performance, social media engagement rates, and referral source attribution. Financial Metrics: Cost-Per-Lead (CPL) for paid campaigns and total revenue influenced by marketing initiatives. Cadence: Deliver concise, actionable weekly and monthly performance dashboards to leadership. Required Skills & Qualifications: Core Marketing & Strategy Expertise: Full-Funnel Growth Marketing: Proven experience in designing, executing, and optimizing end-to-end multi-channel growth campaigns. Brand Positioning & Messaging Architecture: Strong ability to define, clarify, and maintain distinct brand voices and core positioning strategies across multiple diverse brands. Content & Editorial Strategy: Experience building holistic content plans, mapping business goals to content themes, and maximizing asset ROI through strategic repurposing. Omnichannel Audience Cultivation: Expertise in tailoring growth and organic social media strategies across key platforms (including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook , YouTube, and TikTok) depending on targeted brand verticals. Community Lifecycle & Lead Generation: Deep conceptual understanding of conversion funnels, subscriber acquisition, landing page optimization, and sustainable community growth models. Strategic Partnership Coordination: Experience identifying, building, and maintaining collaborative B2B partnerships and managing outreach campaigns. Data-Informed Decision Making: Competency in tracking core KPIs (leads, traffic, conversions, engagement) and synthesizing them into actionable weekly and monthly performance reports. Leadership & Project Coordination: Cross-Functional Team Management: Demonstrated ability to coordinate, direct, and review the outputs of creative teams, including graphic designers, content creators, editors, and community managers. Multi-Brand Orchestration: Exceptional organizational skills to seamlessly manage and switch between multiple brand portfolios simultaneously without sacrificing quality or brand integrity. Remote Collaboration: Fully comfortable and effective working independently within a distributed, remote team environment. Advanced Project Management: Strong project coordination skills with a sharp eye for timelines, deliverables, resource allocation, and workflow optimization. Communication Excellence: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex marketing strategies and write clear, compelling briefs. Preferred Skills & Qualifications: (Note: These qualifications are not mandatory but highly advantageous.) Domain & Audience Vertical Experience Digital Ecosystem Expertise: Prior experience in marketing SaaS platforms, mobile applications, coaching programs, online communities, or digital product launches. Niche Audience Familiarity: Experience engaging and crafting messaging for distinct demographics, including faith-based networks, educational spaces, wellness/mindfulness communities, or small business owners. Specialized Content Skills: Strong foundational copywriting skills for email , web, and social media, alongside an understanding of SEO best practices and blog strategy. Event Architecture: Experience in digital event marketing, including webinar funnels and live-stream activation. Technical & Tool Proficiencies: Marketing Automation & CRMs: Hands-on experience with email marketing ecosystems and CRM suites (e.g., HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, Mailchimp, or similar). Creative & Platform Operations: Familiarity with design, management, and publishing suites like Canva and Meta Business Suite. Analytics Dashboards: Experience navigating data platforms such as Google Analytics and Looker Studio to pull performance metrics. Vendor Operations: Experience scouting, hiring, and managing external contractors, freelancers, or creative agencies. Experience: 10+ years of proven experience in a similar role or scaling environment. Core Soft Skills: Strong communication, collaborative leadership style, and an ability to thrive in agile environments. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. What we offer: Competitive renumeration. Flexible work hours & remote options. Opportunity to work on multiple exciting projects in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and innovative team culture.

title: DTC Ecommerce Customer Support Rep
description: We run fast-scaling direct-to-consumer eCommerce brands selling across multiple countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia. We are looking for an experienced, long-term Customer Service tea ---------- mber to join our team and own our inbox from day one. There is a great deal of growth opportunity for those who consistently make a positive contribution to our brand as we scale. This isn't just "answer tickets" work; it's retention-focused support that directly protects revenue. You will handle daily tickets involving order modifications, cancellations, shipping delay inquiries, returns/exchanges, and—most importantly—saving refunds through proactive resolution. We are looking for someone who genuinely loves helping people, can guide hesitant shoppers to a purchase, and instinctively tries to save the sale when issues arise. MUST HAVE KNOWLEDGE OF THESE PLATFORMS: Shopify (eCommerce platform) Gorgias, Commslayer, or similar** (centralized ticketing tools) Klaviyo (email /customer flows) ---------- (team communication channel) Google Sheets (reporting and tracking) What You'll Do: Retention & Resolution: De-escalate refund requests and proactively convert them to exchanges or store credit wherever possible. Order Management: Modify, cancel, and track orders directly in Shopify (Customer Service role access). Inbox Ownership: Respond to all customer inquiries via our centralized inbox in a timely and accurate manner (maintaining a strict 24-hour resolution ETA). Proactive Support: Flag shipping issues before customers ask, and actively assist pre-sale customers by answering product questions to drive conversions. Process Execution: Process returns and exchanges strictly per our SOP library, while contributing to and improving our support documentation. What We Need From You: Proven DTC Experience: Minimum 2 years in eCommerce Customer Support with hands-on experience using Shopify and ticketing tools like Gorgias or Commslayer. Strong Written Communication: Fluent English with an empathetic, efficient, and consistently on-brand voice. Retention Mindset: You instinctively try to save the sale before issuing a refund. Reliability & Honesty: We don't need you to be perfect; we need you to follow SOPs carefully, ask questions when you are confused or unsure about something, and not make us explain things twice. Availability: Part-time to start (3–4 hrs/day) with consistent daily coverage. This role offers a clear path to full-time as volume grows. You must also be available for weekly team calls and ready to join immediately. We will provide you with: - An SOP library for repeatable tasks and pre-written templates. - Direct access to the Team Lead to answer all your questions and handle edge-case escalations. Ultimately, we want to work with a dedicated problem-solver who thrives on resolving issues, protecting brand revenue, and making customers feel valued. How to Apply: Please respond with the following: 1. Your Experience: Briefly tell us about your past DTC support experience. 2. One-Line Pitch: Tell us why you are the "retention-first" rep we need.

title: AEO / SEO Specialist
description: About Intellezy Intellezy helps organizations upskill their teams with a training video library, custom eLearning, and AI adoption services. We’re a lean, high-output team where great work gets noticed and every role has direct impact on growth. The Role We’re looking for an AEO / SEO Specialist who knows how to make content win, not just in Google, but in AI-powered answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. You’ll own the strategy and execution behind organic visibility: building topic authority, optimizing existing content, and writing new assets that rank, get cited, and convert. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Manager and collaborate with our content contributors, developers, and subject matter experts to drive qualified traffic and generate leads. What You’ll Do • SEO & AEO Strategy ? Develop and execute a content strategy that grows organic traffic, topical authority, and AI answer placements across priority keyword clusters. ? Conduct keyword research using SEMrush and Ahrefs; identify high-intent, commercially valuable opportunities aligned to our buyers. ? Build and maintain topic cluster maps, content calendars, and a pipeline of net-new and refresh opportunities. ? Monitor industry shifts in how AI engines surface content (AI Overviews, LLMs, PAA) and adapt strategy accordingly. • Content Creation & Optimization ? Write and optimize long-form blog posts, service/landing pages, and FAQs structured for both traditional SERP and AI answer surfaces. ? Apply AEO best practices: entity-rich language, structured Q&A, clear definitions, TL;DRs, and concise direct answers that AI engines can easily cite. ? Implement and coordinate on-page SEO: title tags, H-tags, internal linking, anchor text, alt text, meta descriptions, and image optimization. ? Implement schema markup (Article, FAQPage, HowTo, VideoObject, Course) in coordination with the development team. ? Audit and upgrade existing content to improve rankings, engagement, and AI citation frequency. • Technical SEO ? Conduct regular site audits to identify and resolve crawlability, indexation, page speed, and structured data issues. ? Work with developers on site architecture, redirect management, canonical tags, and Core Web Vitals improvements. ? Monitor and maintain a healthy site via Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO audit tools. • Measurement & Reporting ? Track and report on organic sessions, keyword rankings, AI mention/citation volume, featured snippet share, and assisted conversions. ? Deliver regular performance updates to the Marketing Manager with clear insights and recommended actions. ? Use data to continuously prioritize the highest-impact content and technical work. What You’ve Done (Qualifications) • 3–6 years of hands-on SEO experience with a documented track record of growing organic traffic and rankings in a B2B environment — be prepared to show before/after data (SaaS, eLearning, or professional services a plus). • Proven AEO expertise: experience writing specifically to capture AI Overviews, LLM citations, and featured snippets, not just traditional SEO rankings. Concrete examples of content that landed in AI answer surfaces are a strong plus. • Portfolio of long-form content (blogs, pillar pages, landing pages) backed by real performance data: rankings, traffic growth, or conversion impact, not just writing samples. • Proficient with SEMrush and/or Ahrefs for keyword research, competitor analysis, and site audits; comfortable in Google Search Console and GA4. • Working knowledge of schema markup and how to implement or coordinate structured data updates. • Comfortable with HubSpot CMS (or similar) and basic HTML/CSS for on-page formatting and implementation. • Strong writer with editorial judgment: you can produce publication-ready content, not just keyword-stuffed drafts. • Bonus: Experience in L&D, corporate training, or HR tech; familiarity with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or AI productivity tools. How We’ll Measure Success (KPIs) • Growth in organic sessions, non-brand keyword rankings, and share of AI answer placements. • Increases in featured snippet captures, PAA presence, and topical authority scores across priority clusters. • Content output velocity: quality-optimized assets shipped per month and time-to-publish on new content. • Conversion contribution: organic-attributed leads and assisted conversions from content you own. Tools You’ve Used SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, HubSpot CMS, Microsoft Word, schema generators, and AI writing/research tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot). Work Style • Self-directed and proactive; you identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be asked. • Data-informed but not data-paralyzed; you can act on directional signals and refine as you learn. • Strong communicator who can explain SEO and AEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. • Organized and deadline-driven; comfortable managing multiple content workstreams simultaneously. Why Intellezy • Mission-driven team improving how people learn at work. • High ownership role with direct impact on pipeline and revenue. • Supportive culture, competitive compensation, and flexible remote work. Location: Remote Team: Marketing Reports to: Marketing Manager *We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

title: Executive Operations & Client Success Concierge
description: Job Description: Executive Operations & Client Success Concierge About the role: An established personal-development and coaching business (content-driven online education grounded in neuroscience and resilience) is hiring a warm, proactive right hand. The founder is a sought-after coach, speaker, and content creator who is systematizing the business so it runs smoothly and is preparing to launch a second brand. This person becomes the welcoming face of the client experience and the founder's operational right hand, and grows with the company across both brands. Role overview: You are the person clients meet first and the founder leans on daily. You guide new clients through a warm, well-run onboarding, support them through their journey, and quietly keep the operation moving behind the scenes: client systems, travel, inbox, and AI-assisted workflows. You wake up asking what needs to happen today so the founder can coach, speak, create, and sell. This is a proactive ownership role with real client contact, not a back-office task seat. Primary Responsibilities (Client Success & Concierge) Be the friendly face of the brand: run client onboarding calls (about 45 minutes each), welcome new clients, and make them feel cared for from day one. Monitor and support the community message thread, answer common questions, and surface anything that needs the founder. Track client milestones and graduations, and keep each client moving through the program. Act as a gentle gatekeeper, protecting the founder's time while keeping clients feeling close. Onboarding & Operations (GoHighLevel) Run the GoHighLevel onboarding workflow end to end: confirm the client is in the CRM, apply the correct onboarding tag so the automations fire, and set up each client's folder cleanly. Use the sales-call transcript and an AI project to assemble each client's goals and roadmap accurately. Keep backend systems organized and document SOPs so the business runs without constant founder input. Executive Support Own personal and executive travel end to end: flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries, anticipating needs, handling changes, and managing related spend responsibly. Triage the founder's inbox, surface what needs attention, and draft responses where appropriate. LinkedIn & Outreach Support Manage the LinkedIn inbox and monitor automated outreach in HeyReach, sending approved, templated replies and timely follow-ups (content posting is handled separately). Flag inbound opportunities (podcasts, speaking, partnerships) and prepare them for founder review in short, focused co-working sessions where the founder makes the final call. AI & Systems Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up onboarding, content assembly, and admin, and help build and maintain simple AI projects against the business's knowledge base. Required skills (must-have, screened directly) Genuine client-facing warmth and presence, with strong judgment about people and situations. This is the heart of the role. Proven experience supporting a coach, creator, or solo founder as an EA or client success lead. Demonstrated hands-on travel management for a principal, including anticipating needs, handling changes, and managing spend and reconciliation. Comfortable and credible working within a Christian and scripture-based context, to support the founder's second brand. Excellent spoken and written English with a neutral, easy-to-understand accent for client calls. Highly organized, reliable, and proactive: anticipates needs and takes direction once, then runs with it. Important and strongly preferred (trainable) GoHighLevel experience. It is the primary onboarding and client-management system and matters, but it is teachable, so strong candidates without it are still worth considering. Working knowledge of AI tools and prompting (training provided). HeyReach or similar LinkedIn outreach tools. Light content production or coordination.

Why this role matters In a category built on trust, the technical decisions are the business. Whether a session holds, whether data stays safe, whether the platform feels solid that's what earns the trust everything else depends on. As a founding-tea ---------- mber you'll build the foundation MindFriend grows on, and shape the company from its first day live. This is a rare chance to own the technical heart of a company at the ---------- nt it matters most Benefits What we offer A founding-team seat working directly to the founder, with real authority and real ownership of the problems that matter most. A product that's already built and a launch to drive, not a blank page. Competitive cash compensation plus equity, reflecting the seniority and ownership of the role. And a mission worth the work making trustworthy mental-health support easier to find. title: Backend / Operations Manager
description: About us We run a portfolio of fast-growing e-commerce brands across Australia, the UK, US and Canada. Our flagship is a designer lighting brand; the portfolio also spans fashion and home. We're profitable and scaling hard — which means the operational side now needs a dedicated owner instead of being run off the founder's desk. The role in one line Own the day-to-day backend of every store so the operation runs cleanly without the founder in the loop — and turn the money we currently lose to refunds, chargebacks and fulfilment issues into margin we keep. This is not a ticket-closing job. You'll run the operation and improve the systems behind it. Right now roughly 15% of profit leaks to refunds and related issues. Your core mandate is to bring that down meaningfully (target: under 5%) through better process, not just faster firefighting. What you'll own Fulfilment & orders — Make sure every paid order ships within 48 hours, supplier transit times are met, and no order ever sits open. D ---------- on substitutions and out-of-stock situations using our playbook. Refunds — Apply our refund decision matrix (replacement-first where appropriate, store credit before cash, cause-based logic). Approve within your limit; escalate above it. Tag every refund by cause and whether it was preventable. Customer support quality — You don't do the CS yourself; you run quality control over a distributed support team. Monitor first response time, enforce correct template usage, make sure refund/issue tickets get prioritised and resolved fast. Chargebacks — Respond within processor deadlines with proper evidence, and — more importantly — find the root causes and seal the leaks. Keeping our chargeback rate healthy is a priority. Data & optimisation — Own data integrity across our sheets and dashboards. Surface where the leakage concentrates (which supplier, SKU, market) and propose the one or two fixes that move the number each month. This is the part of the job that actually compounds. KPIs you'll be measured on - Refund cost as % of profit (by cause) — trending down - Customer first response time within target - % of issue tickets resolved within 3 exchanges - Chargeback count and % preventable - Orders processed within 48h / supplier SLA hit rate - Data completeness across all tracking You're a fit if you: - Have run operations or backend for a Shopify / dropshipping business before (multi-store and multi-market is a strong plus) Are comfortable with the stack: Shopify, Google Merchant Center, a CS platform (we use Re:amaze), email /Klaviyo, spreadsheets/dashboards, Notion - Think in systems — you instinctively turn a recurring problem into a rule or a process, not a repeated manual fix - Are fully fluent in written English and excellent at concise, no-fluff async communication - Are reliable, self-directed, and able to make decisions inside clear guardrails without checking in constantly - Are numbers-literate — margins, COG, refund rates, chargeback rates mean something to you Nice to have: experience disputing chargebacks, supplier/SLA management and comfort with custom dashboards. How we work: - Fully remote, full-time. - Async-first. You'll run a short daily written standup, a weekly KPI report, and a monthly optimisation note. Real-time messages are reserved for genuine escalations. - You get a clear SOP (decision matrix) from day one and a structured onboarding where you take over tasks in phases over your first 8 weeks. - We measure you on outcomes, not hours online.

description: We are looking for a technical person in Cebu City or nearby who can help us set up Claude Code and AI automation systems for our business. This is not a normal VA role. We need someone who is comfortable following technical setup instructions, using terminals, connecting tools, testing automations, and troubleshooting when something does not work the first time. You do not need to be a senior developer, but you must be technical, patient, detail-oriented, and willing to figure things out. The main goal of this role is simple: Help us set up working Claude Code automations and document the setup clearly so the process can be repeated later. You will be helping with things like: Setting up Claude Code on a computer Running commands in terminal Connecting APIs, webhooks, Google Sheets, CRMs, email tools, and automation platforms Following detailed SOPs step by step Testing automations to make sure they work properly Troubleshooting setup errors by Googling, reading docs, and trying fixes Recording what was done so another person can repeat it Turning messy technical steps into clear setup notes Tools you may work with: Claude Code, ChatGPT, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, Make/Zapier-style automation tools, APIs, webhooks, browser tools, code editors, terminals, email tools, and CRMs. You do not need to already know every tool. What matters most is that you can learn quickly, follow instructions carefully, and solve setup problems without needing constant hand-holding. This role is a good fit for someone who: Is naturally technical Has used terminals, code editors, APIs, GitHub, webhooks, or automation tools before Can follow a detailed setup guide without skipping steps Can troubleshoot errors independently before asking for help Can explain what they did in simple language Is comfortable with technical dashboards, settings pages, and documentation Is available to meet in Cebu City if needed for initial setup/onboarding This role is not a good fit if: You only want basic VA/data entry work You are not comfortable using technical tools You give up quickly when an error appears You skip steps or do not document your work You need every small instruction repeated multiple times Work setup: Cebu City preferred. Remote is okay for the right person, but being able to meet in person for initial onboarding is a big advantage. This will start with a paid test project. If the test goes well, this can become an ongoing role. Compensation: Starting at 30,000–40,000 PHP/month depending on skill level and results. Higher pay is possible if you can independently set up and troubleshoot automation systems. 40 hours/week preferred, but we can start with a paid test project first. To apply, answer these carefully. Generic or AI-looking answers will be skipped. 1. Tell me about one technical setup you personally completed. Do not describe your general skills. Pick one real setup and explain: - What tool/software you set up - What the goal was - What broke during setup - What you tried first - What finally fixed it - How you proved it was working 2. Imagine I give you access to a laptop and ask you to set up Claude Code from scratch. What would you check before you begin? Give me your actual checklist. 3. You are following an SOP and step 14 does not work because the terminal shows an error. What exactly do you do in the next 20 minutes before asking me for help? 4. Explain these in simple words: - API - Webhook - Terminal command - Environment variable - GitHub repository - Automation workflow 5. Give an example of a time you connected two tools together. What were the two tools, what data moved between them, and how did you confirm it worked? 6. When documenting a technical setup for someone else, what screenshots or notes would you include so they can repeat it without you? 7. You are setting up an automation and it works once, but fails the second time. What are the first things you would check? 8. What is one technical thing you do not know yet, but you are confident you could figure out? Explain how you would learn it. 9. Small thinking test: Imagine I give you a Google Sheet with customer names, email s, and statuses. I want Claude Code or another automation tool to check the sheet every day, find rows marked “Ready,” create a draft email for each one, and update the row to “Draft Created.” Explain: - What tools you would use - What access you would need - What steps you would take first - How you would test it safely - What could go wrong - How you would document it after it works 10. Record a 2–3 minute Loom video explaining any technical setup, automation, tool, or workflow you have used before. It does not need to be advanced. I want to see how clearly you explain steps. At the top of your application, write: “I can troubleshoot before escalating.”
